name: Fran Hong
subject: These are the facts
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Francesca Hong
body:
They pay more. You pay less.
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260507-2794)
Peter,
I think it's time to rename my Tax the Rich policy. A more accurate title would be "Tax the Super Rich, Make Big Corporations Pay Their Fair Share, and Lower Taxes for Working People.”
Here’s what I’m proposing:
1. **A new top tax bracket for households earning over $1 million.** Roughly 9,300 Wisconsin filers fall into this bracket, and frankly, they can afford it. The higher rate only applies to dollars above the threshold, so a couple earning $1.2 million pays the new rate on that $200,000.
2. **A 1.2-point increase on the existing top bracket.** For couples earning above $431,000 (and $323,000 for single filers) the rate goes up by just over one percentage point. That means a couple earning $500,000 pays about $830 more per year. The lower tax brackets, where the vast majority of Wisconsinites live, don't move at all.
3. **A new corporate income tax bracket on profits above $1 million.** This is about big, profitable corporations that disproportionately benefit from our current tax code. And critically, this only applies to C-corporations — the vast majority of Wisconsin's small businesses are LLCs, S-corps, sole proprietorships, and partnerships, which won't be impacted.

**Why it works:** Every dollar raised goes straight back to Wisconsin's public schools. Special education reimbursement rises from 42% to 90%. School districts can finally stop going to referendum after referendum just to cover the basics. And Wisconsin's economy benefits when every kid in the state gets the world-class education they deserve.
**And the cherry on top? Property taxes will decrease up to 44%.**
Tax the Super Rich, Make Big Corporations Pay Their Fair Share, and Lower Taxes for Working People. It’s a terrible name for a policy, but it’s a great idea for Wisconsin.
**[If that sounds good to you, chip in $44 to help us make it happen.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260507.erHvjl&refcode=em20260507-2794&t=1&akid=2794%2E105371%2E8CJtGn)**

With gratitude,
Fran

| | Dear Peter,
Right now, millions of working people in the United States are facing a harsh reality. Healthcare has been getting more and more expensive for decades, and **last year Republicans and some Democrats decided to allow the Affordable Care Act subsidies to expire, causing health insurance premiums to skyrocket even more**. People across the country are being forced to make impossible choices — pay more, go without coverage, or risk medical debt.
At the same time, the war on Iran has taken thousands of lives so far and thrown the Middle East into further crisis. This comes on top of the devastating and ongoing genocide being carried out by the Israeli state against the Palestinian people. **All of this war and bloodshed and genocide has been fully backed by the Republican AND Democratic parties.** Even the most "progressive" wing of the Democratic Party is complicit, as we saw when Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez voted **against** cutting $500 million of military aid to Israel. **Kshama's opponent, Democratic Congressman Adam Smith, voted along with hundreds of Democrats just last year to send Trump a $900 billion blank check for war.**
---

**Saturday, May 9 @ 2pm PT
Casa Latina**, 317 17th Ave SSeattle, WA, 98144
**Not in Seattle? Join one of our in-person meetings to watch the livestream followed by discussion:**
* **Peoria, IL** @ 3:45pm CT - Central Illinois FRIENDS Community Center, 2112 E War Memorial Dr
* **Rochester, MN** @ 3:45pm CT - Rochester Public Library, 2nd Floor, at 101 2nd St SE
* **San Jose, CA** @ 2pm PT - MLK Library, Room #764, at 150 E San Fernando St
* [**Livestream online**](https://us.list-manage.com/108vpHF2MLs?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) @ 2pm PT / 4pm CT / 5pm ET

**We need to defeat corporate genocidal Democrat Adam Smith—and elect the first-ever revolutionary socialist to Congress!**
---
| [RSVP NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/mqaJBnpvVyI?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
---
| |
Last year when Trump and the Republicans carried out devastating cuts of over $1 trillion from Medicaid and Medicare, the Democratic Party chose not to fight back. These two programs cover health insurance for 144 million people — nearly two in five Americans.
The Democratic Party has control of the state House, state Senate, and Governorship in California, Illinois, and Washington state. They could have used those so-called “trifectas” to tax the rich for free healthcare for all. They didn’t, because **the Democratic Party represents the same billionaire and multimillionaire interests as the Republican Party**.
In fact, just last month, the California Legislature quietly shut down yet another attempt to establish a state-run single payer health care system.
Kshama’s opponent Adam Smith has been in office almost three decades and has given nothing but lip service to the dire healthcare crisis facing working people. Recently he signed on to sponsor a Medicare for All bill in order to whitewash his image as he faces his toughest opponent ever. This is a decades old strategy of Democrats, to sponsor progressive bills that they have no intention of fighting for, in order to create the illusion that their party is for working people. But Adam Smith has voted for every war and for trillions of dollars for all of those wars — money that could have instead been spent on healthcare to dramatically improve people's lives.
The Democratic Party is utterly rotten. They are more afraid of working-class movements than they are of Trump. Working people need a new party of our own. A party whose leaders fight against the bosses and all of their political servants.
We urgently need leaders who will fight to stop the endless violence of the billionaire-backed Democratic and Republican parties. We need leaders who will build movements to win what working people need, like a healthcare system that is free to use when you need it because it's fully funded by taxing the rich.**Kshama Sawant has an unparalleled track record as a fighter for working people—we need to fight to elect Kshama to Congress.**
**Kshama used her elected Seattle City Council position to lead movements that won the highest minimum wage in the nation, the Amazon Tax, many landmark renters' rights laws, Seattle’s Indigenous Peoples’ Day, free abortion, and much more.**
**Kshama is now using her campaign for Congress to fight for free healthcare for all funded by taxing the rich, to end the war on Iran and end all military aid to Israel, and to stop all weapons and tech for genocide and imperialist war.** Winning these victories will require mass organized civil disobedience and strike action. Building such movements will require fighting independent leaders, because the overwhelming majority of the left and labor leadership is tied at the hip to the Democratic Party and opposed to building working-class power.
**We need leaders like Kshama, with a proven track record of winning unparalleled victories for working people.** Let's fight to elect the first ever revolutionary socialist to the U.S. Congress!
Solidarity,Kshama for Congress

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: ABQ Council finally cracked down on homeless crisis
body:
Plus: did you catch what MLG looked like at the Derby? | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/YA0qMEzTxtf?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
After eight years of inaction, Albuquerque City Council [finally did something](https://us.list-manage.com/10EK629Jg56?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) about the homeless crisis.
Meanwhile, Trump just made Sen. John Fetterman an offer no Democrat has ever gotten. **And did you catch what MLG wore to the Derby?!?**
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/lqEHOd0Z3IG?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🏛️ **ALBUQUERQUE COUNCIL FINALLY CRACKS DOWN**
The 6-3 vote passed Monday night. Democrat Joaquín Baca crossed the aisle and made the case that finally gave Mayor Tim Keller the cover he's needed for years.
Baca's quote on what real compassion looks like — versus the indifference of letting people die on the streets — is the line that should have been said a long time ago.
The real question now is whether the mayor actually enforces this, or whether the ordinance just stays on paper. Mark and Krysty get into it.

🏛️ **TRUMP'S QUIET PITCH TO FETTERMAN**
Politico just reported it: Trump has personally offered Sen. John Fetterman his total endorsement — plus a financial windfall — to flip to the GOP.
The most damning detail isn't the pitch. It's where Fetterman is eating lunch now.
His own party has frozen him out. He's spending hours in the GOP cloakroom. Sen. Katie Britt brings him meals.
Then Gov. Josh Shapiro went on national TV and said the quiet part out loud about how Democrats expect their senators to vote.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/ECcrIXE4S4u?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
🏇 **OH, AND THE GOVERNOR WORE A JOCKEY SUIT TO THE DERBY**
Custom-made. "MLG" on the front. A Zia sign on the chest.
The Santa Fe New Mexican called her "pint-sized." Forbes ran the photo.
**There is nobody left in that governor's office willing to tell her no. You need to see who she's standing next to.

** 🇺🇸 **RUBIO IN THE BAG**
Marco Rubio is filling in for Karoline Leavitt while she's on maternity leave. Mark says he's never seen him this comfortable behind a podium.
His answer on Iran — the people vs. the regime — is something we haven't heard from a Republican administration in a long time.
---

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: The Melania documentary
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Add your name if you want Amazon to give the American people answers

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2890%2E4032634%2E22w_dP)
---
I'm finally ready to share my review of the Melania movie with you. Just kidding. But in the time I could have spent watching it, I started asking some very serious questions — because what's happening here goes far beyond a documentary. Here's what we know: Amazon paid $40 million for the rights to the Melania film. Of that, about $28 million goes directly into Melania Trump's pocket. Amazon reportedly beat the next-highest bidder by a whopping $26 million. But the film didn’t even make $16.6 million at the box office. And it doesn’t appear that Amazon expects to break even. So why would one of the most powerful corporations in the world lose tens of millions of dollars on a movie? That’s what I want to find out. And I need you by my side to stay on this. [**Want to know why Amazon overpaid by tens of millions for a Trump family film while billions in federal favors were also up for consideration? Add your name to join me in demanding answers.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-amazon/?source=EW_EMZ31B_AMZ_ENG_20260507_F&t=8&akid=2890%2E4032634%2E22w_dP) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-amazon/?source=EW_EMZ31B_AMZ_ENG_20260507_F&t=9&akid=2890%2E4032634%2E22w_dP)
---
Is Jeff Bezos and Amazon willing to do whatever it takes to promote Mrs. Trump’s vanity project because they have a mountain of business pending before the Trump administration?
* A major **FTC antitrust lawsuit** that could fundamentally reshape Amazon's business model
* **Foreign trade deals** where Amazon lobbied the administration to bully other countries into dropping regulations
* **Corporate tax cuts** that have already shaved billions off Amazon's tax bill — last year alone, Amazon's federal tax bill dropped by 87%

Does that sound like it could be a bribe to you? I had the same question.
Federal anti-bribery laws prohibit offering anything of value to elected officials to influence their official acts.
And while we're on the subject of corruption, let’s not forget about the Trump Presidential Library fund.
Amazon, Meta, Paramount, X, and ABC all settled lawsuits with Trump by promising up to $63 million in donations to his presidential library.
But then that fund was mysteriously dissolved. So where did THAT money go?
Not one of those corporations could give a clear answer about where their multimillion-dollar donations are. And Trump certainly isn’t offering up any information on the subject.
[**If you want answers about Amazon’s payments to the Trump family, add your name here.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-amazon/?source=EW_EMZ31B_AMZ_ENG_20260507_F&t=10&akid=2890%2E4032634%2E22w_dP)
Donald Trump has turned the presidency into a nightmare of corruption.
This is exactly what I've been warning about. And I'm not going to stop fighting until we get real answers.
Thanks for being part of this,
Elizabeth

============================================================

Good afternoon!

We’re excited to invite you to the Grand Opening Celebration of the newly improved San Bruno Mountain Day Use Area!

Join San Mateo County Parks, California State Parks, and community members as we celebrate exciting new improvements that make this beautiful outdoor space more welcoming and accessible for everyone.

📅 Wednesday, May 13, 2026
⏰ 11:00 AM
📍 Saddle Area – San Bruno Mountain
555 Guadalupe Canyon Parkway, Brisbane, CA

The improvements include:
✅ ADA-accessible picnic areas
✅ Brand-new restroom facility
✅ Interpretive pavilion & displays
✅ Scenic mountain views
✅ Family-friendly outdoor gathering space

Enjoy a fun community ribbon-cutting celebration, photo opportunities, and the chance to explore one of our county’s most scenic outdoor destinations.

Bring a picnic, enjoy the fresh air, and celebrate this exciting park improvement project with us!

We hope to see you there. Please RSVP to Mike: ** mrichardson@smcgov.org (mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org?subject=May%2013th%20Event%20)

David J. Canepa

#
Hey Peter – it's Sherrod Brown.
**We're on the air with our first ad. This is the moment when things kick into high gear.**
Going on the air is a pivotal moment for a campaign. We're making crucial budget decisions every day, and whether or not we hit our daily grassroots fundraising goals determines if we can keep these ads running – or if we need to take them down.
The role that this team plays becomes even more important, Peter. It's because of generous folks chipping in a couple bucks here and there that we've been able to launch our first ad so early and with such force. Now, I need you to step up again.
In a state like Ohio, we can’t afford to leave a single stone unturned. That means running ads far and wide and reaching voters in every single corner.
National Republicans are already pouring $80 million into Ohio and we’re expecting millions more to come, so we have to replenish our ads stockpile constantly. **[Will you rush $15 – split between my campaign and State Democrats Committee – to help us keep these ads on the air so we can reach all Ohioans, flip this seat, and take back the Senate majority?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/104447?refcode=em20260507-10466&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=15&t=1&akid=10466%2E614464%2ErWMQav)**

name: Christine Bish
subject: CA Families are being priced out of their homes
body:
That is absolutely unacceptable.
---
| | | | [ View in browser](https://m4s4f.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/mr/sh/WCPxRrNLV1LtwSCEGcqYZQVm93Fhn2uH/i8g2PI0L7BsM)
---
| | | | |
---
| | | | Friends,
Wildfire season used to mean watching the hills, checking evacuation routes, and praying the wind did not shift toward our communities.
Now the crisis is hitting families before a fire even starts.
Homeowners across California’s 3rd Congressional District are being dropped by insurance carriers, pushed into expensive state-mandated coverage, or forced to wonder whether they can afford to stay in the home they worked for years to buy.
That is absolutely unacceptable.
Gavin Newsom has allowed this crisis to get worse while families in foothill and mountain communities pay the price. Ami Bera has had years in Washington, and our families are still stuck with rising premiums, shrinking coverage, and no serious federal plan to stabilize the market.
**That’s why I am running for Congress. Because our district needs a representative who understands this crisis and is ready to fix it.**
---

| [ SEND CHRISTINE TO CONGRESS TO FIX THIS!](https://m4s4f.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ6uvfh6CvvTeS466g94v5105/tV2M7aPcci0D)
---
|
**I recently announced my Wildfire Act, a federal proposal designed to protect communities, lower long-term costs, and restore real stability to the wildfire insurance market.**
This plan focuses on prevention before disaster strikes. It rewards homeowners and communities that reduce risk, strengthens coordination between federal and local agencies, and creates a responsible framework to help restore access to coverage in wildfire-prone areas.
_For families in Truckee, South Lake Tahoe, Grass Valley, Placerville, Auburn, El Dorado County, and across the foothills, this is not some distant policy debate._
This is about whether people can keep their homes insured.
This is about whether families can afford their mortgage.
**This is about whether our communities have a future while Sacramento and Washington keep reacting after the damage is done.**

---

| | |
---
| | | [**I also sat down with ABC10 to discuss this proposal because I want voters to know exactly what I will fight for in Congress.**](https://m4s4f.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ72ijjJTI0xKDoFtovy2KicD/Yb8pXiUxl0cP)
**California families need relief. Our firefighters need support. Our local governments need a serious partner. Homeowners need a system that rewards mitigation and restores confidence instead of leaving them trapped in uncertainty.**
_The primary is coming up fast, and this campaign needs the resources to carry this message across the district._
Bera will have the establishment behind him.
Newsom’s allies will keep defending the same failed policies that helped create this mess.
[**I am asking you to help me take this fight directly to the voters who are living with the consequences.**](https://m4s4f.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7AVnlWje6QzzYPgxir9aQEL/GMUtZV1esRMf)
---
| | | | [ DONATE NOW TO SAVE CALIFORNIA!](https://m4s4f.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7IIrnk00BuflIZU6VkGq7qT/8nN0R4K0gS8Q)
---
| | [******Your support helps us reach more families, promote this plan, and build the campaign operation we need to win.**](https://m4s4f.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7Q5vpxGMHOLX2jHFIdO5pSb/pwRYlKHtpS3u)
California’s 3rd District deserves leadership, and YOU deserve leadership that sees the danger clearly and acts before another crisis gets worse. Before another fire destroys our homes.
I am ready to fight for that in Congress. And I am ready to fight for you and your family.
Thank you for your support,Christine BishCandidate for Congress, CA-03
---
| | | |
---

Peter, at the last four debates, Katie showed up the way she always does—focused on the facts, grounded in reality, and fighting for working families.
Katie gets it. She knows firsthand what it means when rent eats up half a paycheck. She’s lived the struggles of juggling child care costs, rising prices, and making the tough choices of what has to give.
And instead of dodging those challenges, she broke them down the way she always does— _with a plan to actually fix them._
The rest of the stage? Same old story.
A self-funding billionaire trying to buy the seat.
A candidate bankrolled by Big Oil.

name: Danielle Bethell for Governor
subject: The People I’m Fighting For
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Danielle Bethell PAC 20220 [Preferences](https://daniellebethell
body:
I’ll never forget the people who helped me when I was young. And I’ll never stop fighting for the people who feel unseen in Oregon today.
[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-akiuldk-hhlrhljhit-r/) Friends,There are parts of your life that shape who you become long before anyone knows your name or sees you on a debate stage.This post from Connie hit me hard because she was there during some of the hardest years of my life. [](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-akiuldk-hhlrhljhit-y/) Connie knew me as a teenager when life was unstable, uncertain, and sometimes overwhelming. There were periods where I was trying to hold together school, work, family struggles, and simply figuring out where I was going to sleep or how I was going to keep moving forward. Connie never judged me. She never treated me like I was broken or disposable. She simply made space for me to breathe, regroup, and believe I could still build a future.She bought me my first work uniform.That may sound like a small thing to some people, but when you're young and struggling, those moments stay with you forever. Connie showed me that people can choose to care about someone even when they don't have to. She showed me grace, stability, and kindness at a time in my life when I desperately needed all three.There are very few adults who had a front row seat to those years of my life. Connie did.And I think about that often now, especially when I travel around Oregon and hear from families who feel like they are barely hanging on. Parents trying to navigate addiction or mental health crises with their kids. Small business owners working nonstop, wondering if they can keep their doors open as costs keep rising and the state keeps adding fees and red tape. Families watching homelessness, crime, and dysfunction spread through communities that once felt safe and stable.If you feel, like I do, that those Oregonians need a Governor who knows what it's like to fight day in and day out, I hope you'll consider donating to our campaign today. May 19 is less than two weeks away, and every dollar donated helps us reach more voters before ballots are due. [Can You Chip In Now?](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-akiuldk-hhlrhljhit-j/) I understand what it feels like when life is uncertain. I understand what it means to need people who step up rather than look away.That experience shaped how I lead as a county commissioner. It shaped why I worked to expand addiction recovery services, crisis stabilization, supportive housing, wildfire recovery efforts, and public safety resources in Marion County. And it shaped why I decided to run for Governor.This race has never been about titles for me. It's about whether Oregon is still a place where people can build a life, raise a family, recover from hardship, and genuinely believe their children can have a better life and that our state's tomorrow will be better than today. I believe it can.But Oregon needs leadership grounded in real-life experience, not political talking points or consultants' scripts. We need leaders who understand these issues because they've lived close enough to them to know the stakes. Leaders who will deliver real results for real people doing real jobs. Not just the insiders and political class. I'll never forget the people who helped me when I was young. And I'll never stop fighting for the people who feel unseen in Oregon today.Thank you, Connie. This campaign is for, and about, Oregonians like you.Danielle Bethell
Republican for Governor**P.S.** Election Day is May 19, and we are in the final stretch of this campaign. If you believe Oregon needs experienced leadership grounded in real life and real results, [I'd be grateful for your support.](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-akiuldk-hhlrhljhit-t/) [](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-akiuldk-hhlrhljhit-i/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-akiuldk-hhlrhljhit-d/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-akiuldk-hhlrhljhit-h/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-akiuldk-hhlrhljhit-k/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-fb-akiuldk-hhlrhljhit-x/) | [ Tweet ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-tw-akiuldk-hhlrhljhit-m/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-li-akiuldk-hhlrhljhit-c/) | [ Forward ](https://daniellebethell.forwardtomyfriend.com/y-hhlrhljhit-E19159AE-akiuldk-l-q)

name: James =?UTF-8?B?T8Oi4oKs4oSiS2VlZmU=?=
subject: They tried to destroy me. Look at me now.
body:
Arrested. Raided. Betrayed. Sued. Still standing.

|
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zm18oqscbl3aembet93rsbajq7kkc6omtc8pomog_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs)
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsho17pflp88gur9prr2j1llo3n88uajrbg45bgg_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cannot-be-beaten-mb?utm_source=omg-cannot-be-beaten&utm_medium=tld&utm_campaign=20260508&utm_content=aan&amount=35")Dear Friend,

I posted a picture of myself this weekend. Buzzed head. Cold stare. No smile.

A friend of mine looked at it and said, "You don't even look like the same person."

He's right. I'm not.

I'm 41 years old. I've been doing this work for twenty-two years. And every single one of those years left a mark -- not on my face, but on my spine. On my will. On the thing inside me that refuses to quit.

They tried to destroy me. They arrested me. They raided my home. They sued me. They conspired against me from the inside. They sent a former board member to the FBI to feed them information and try to put me in prison.

And I'm still here.

Not just still here. Stronger than I've ever been. And I need you to understand why -- because your [**support right now is what keeps me in the fight**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt8pge5u7j6n3gacjb92kdj6vmj0g5e1h7o5klq8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs). ****[STAND WITH JAMES-- DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zau1renvj7bua1j5uvh71lmei0u655ranar2o9g8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs)**** Let me take you back to January 2010. I was twenty-five years old. A kid with a camera and a conviction that the truth mattered more than my comfort.

Federal agents put me in handcuffs inside a United States senator's office in New Orleans. They led me out in front of the cameras. Every network in the country ran the footage. "Conservative activist arrested," the chyrons said. They wanted that to be the end of my story.

I was twenty-five. I had no money. No legal team. No powerful friends. Just a belief that citizens had a right to know what their government was doing -- and a willingness to pay the price for acting on it.

That false arrest was supposed to scare me into silence. It did the opposite. It taught me that the people in power will use every weapon they have against anyone who threatens the narrative. And it taught me that I could take the hit and keep walking. ****[KEEP JAMES AND OMG IN THE FIGHT-- DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdu8001i27e6k6n7iulmkngqkpo21c4ffb9sg008_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs)**** Eleven years later, they came for me again. This time they didn't just arrest me. They kicked in my door.

November 2021. FBI agents swarmed my apartment in New York. They put me in handcuffs in my own hallway. They seized my phones. They rifled through my belongings. A journalist -- treated like a criminal in his own home.

Why? Because someone gave us a diary that belonged to the President's daughter. We didn't publish it. We turned it over to law enforcement. **And they raided me anyway**.

Think about that. We did the right thing -- and the FBI showed up at my door at dawn with guns and handcuffs.

The message was clear: We don't care what you did or didn't publish. We want you to know that we can reach you. Anywhere. Anytime.

**[**Can you chip in $35, $50, or $100 right now to help me keep fighting?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znkaa1ug86vatr941gqkjm458nsaq13lguoft7o8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs)**

The raids and the arrests -- those I expected. What I didn't expect was the betrayal from inside.

A man who sat on my own board -- a man I trusted -- went to the FBI and became an informant against me. He admitted it on our hidden cameras. He told our undercover journalist he'd fed "tons of information" to federal law enforcement. Every agency that called, he answered.

Then we found his copy of my book, Breakthrough -- with a rifle bullet fired straight through the heart on the cover. Exit wound out the back. When I confronted him in Miami Beach and asked him about it, he said: "I needed a target."

When I asked if he'd kill me, he called it "a figure of speech."

A figure of speech. A bullet through my heart. From a man who was supposed to protect the organization I built. ****[BACK JAMES AND OMG-- DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8nhnl072kgvim08g2pvv59lg3hunmnlg5h7ld5g_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs)**** I could fill a filing cabinet with the lawsuits they've thrown at me. Pentagon contractors. DOJ officials. Corporate executives. My own former organization sued me after I was forced out by the very board that harbored an FBI informant.

Every lawsuit is designed to do the same thing: bleed me dry. Tie me up in discovery. Drain the resources I need for investigations and redirect them to lawyers. That's how lawfare works -- you don't have to win in court. You just have to make the fight so expensive that your target gives up.

They've been waiting sixteen years for me to give up.

I haven't.

**[**Help me keep going**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5c48tfe719g083lv0ob8qbdfftifm94hkcm8jfo_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs). $35 helps cover a day of fieldwork. $100 funds legal review on an investigation. $250 helps launch the next undercover operation.**

I want to be honest with you about something, because I think you deserve it.

I don't have a normal life. I can't. The opposition is always watching. Always looking for a way to set me up, take me down, catch me in something they can twist into a headline. I've accepted that. There's no turning it off. There's no weekend where I stop being James O'Keefe.

So I channel everything into the work. Into the training. Into the mission. The kid they arrested in Louisiana is gone. In his place is something their attacks created -- a man who has been hit so many times that he's stopped flinching. A man who walks into Antifa headquarters in disguise with hidden cameras rolling. A man who flies to Miami Beach to confront the traitor who shot a bullet through his book. A man who goes back to Minneapolis after receiving a death threat.

**They wanted to break me. Instead, they built something they can 't beat.**

And the results speak for themselves. This year alone, OMG investigations have triggered $253 million in federal contracts being suspended. We forced the Secret Service to suspend an agent who was leaking the Vice President's security details. We've recorded seven FBI and DOJ officials on hidden camera admitting the system is broken. We've generated millions of views -- not because we write opinion columns, but because we show up with cameras where nobody else will.

That's what your donation buys. Not talk. Results.

[**I 'm asking you to stand with me today**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zubeqlo3c749qldesaeouppffo333na8rdnsgje8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs). Not because I need sympathy -- I don't. [**I need resources.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgl1d147874df8cb8a2pu78kbimhk5nederp08s0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs)

**[**$35 covers a background check**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbo5k10drl9i4u6o1qs17skjl8pmij8khcoftdpo_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs)** before we send someone undercover.

**[**$50 helps pay for encrypted equipment**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt51tdrsikn64oiasumq233qf1tk4niaomvgvns0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs)** that keeps our journalists safe.

**[**$100 funds the legal review**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj0nehtsq8jntfmagpjfn3onpc0p7h40uf4npu28_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs)** that lets us publish what the powerful want buried.

**[**$250 helps us launch the next investigation --**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsm3tnfe5jaeipursdso5uq2l68k8054rirmjn90_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs)** because we have more targets than budget.

**[**$500 or more funds a full day of protected field operations.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrpmik7i5k88punrtthlp14sil5roj22heqsnm7o_rp22sh2s8i6epr0s9j61o36cdh2bs)**

They arrested me at twenty-five. They raided me at thirty-seven. They betrayed me from the inside. They sued me from every direction. And here I am at forty-one -- still standing, still fighting, and stronger than I've ever been.

| | | | | **" House Pet."**

**" He lets white men pat him on the head."**

This is what so-called "tolerant & diverse" Democrats like Joy Reid are saying about me for being President Trump's STRONGEST ally.

It's Byron Donalds, and I have to say, I never expected them to be this desperate.

They've called me **" Fascist"** and **" White Supremacist"** before, but attacking me for the color of my skin is truly disgusting.

NOTHING makes them more outraged than seeing a Black man like me who loves his President & our country.

**I 'm a husband, a father, a Christian, and MAGA to the Bone.**

And I will NEVER submit to the attacks that they throw my way, and I will ALWAYS fight for you and every Patriot who loves our country as much as I do.

But what I'm about to admit to you isn't easy.

In fact, this is the most difficult message I've ever had to deliver:

Democrats are spending millions to flip Florida Blue, and if I can't hold the line, the rest of the country will follow.

Look - **all I 've had up to this point is you, President Trump, and the MAGA Movement. **

And the only way we'll win is by keeping MAGA STRONG, right here, right now.

So I'm humbly asking you to join me in sending an unforgettable message to every Democrat who thinks they can get under our skin.

But I know with you and President Trump by my side - **we 'll secure the biggest win our country has ever seen.**

So please, will you join me today and help me deliver a HISTORIC victory for MAGA?

In April 2026, the Supreme Court of the United States delivered its most consequential blow to American voting rights in decades. In Louisiana v. Callais, the Court gutted Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act -- the provision that for over sixty years gave communities of color their only reliable legal tool to challenge maps designed to erase their political power. Without it, states may now draw maps that crush minority representation, call it a partisan decision rather than a racial one, and the courts cannot intervene. As Justice Kagan wrote in dissent, Section 2 is now "all but a dead letter." The last guardrail is gone.

Justice Kagan
That ruling did not come out of nowhere. It was the latest chapter in a decades-long campaign -- planned, funded, and executed with remarkable discipline -- to rig the rules of American democracy before most Americans noticed what was happening.
This series is about that campaign. How it was built. How it works. What it has already cost us. And what -- if anything -- can be done about it.
But before we get into who did what and when, we need to establish something that this series will return to again and again. Because if you walk away from this introduction with one idea, we want it to be this one.
* * *
## **This is not a Republican problem. This is an American problem.**

[Subscribe to Democracy Watch](https://substack.com/@democracywatch1)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ad26aef1-652b-44ba-96ca-022a9c3437b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Gerrymandered Districs](https://substack.com/redirect/014935dc-d36d-49f9-bc54-133e717e4e74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We will document in this series how Republicans built the modern redistricting machine and used it more aggressively, more systematically, and more effectively than Democrats have. That is not a partisan opinion. It is a documented fact, confirmed by the Brennan Center, by academic researchers at Duke, MIT, and Harvard, and by the Republicans who designed the strategy and wrote about it openly at the time.
But Democrats have done it too. After the 2020 census, Democrats in Illinois redrew their congressional map so aggressively that Republicans were left holding just 3 of 17 seats -- in a state where a fair map would have produced roughly 6. That is gerrymandering. It is wrong when Republicans do it in Texas and North Carolina, and it is wrong when Democrats do it in Illinois.
We make this point not to create false equivalence -- the scale and coordination of Republican gerrymandering since 2010 has no Democratic parallel -- but because the argument that this is simply a team sport, where your side's gerrymandering is acceptable and theirs is not, is exactly the kind of thinking that has allowed this problem to fester for decades.
Guardian graphic. Source: Wisconsin State Legislature Data Portal
Here is the thing that most political coverage gets wrong. Republicans are winning the redistricting war. That is true. But winning implies there are two sides in competition and one is ahead. That framing misses what is actually happening -- because the people losing are not Democrats. The people losing are voters. All voters. The scoreboard that matters is not R versus D. It is corporations and wealthy donors on one side, and everyone else on the other. And on that scoreboard, the donors are winning in a landslide -- in red districts and blue districts alike.
Think about what a safe seat actually means in practice. A representative in a gerrymandered district does not need to win a competitive general election. The map guarantees the seat. The only thing that can threaten their career is losing a primary -- and corporate money has now colonized primaries too. Which means there is no longer any moment in the electoral cycle where an ordinary voter's preference reliably determines the outcome.
You can see this in the most basic act of democratic accountability: the town hall. Research drawing on more than 23,000 town hall meetings over eight years found that the average representative holds just nine town halls per Congress -- and many hold none at all during the two years between elections. In March 2025, the chair of the National Republican Congressional Committee advised members in a closed-door meeting to stop holding in-person town halls entirely. The House Speaker agreed. Several Texas Republicans replaced public forums with private meetings -- not with constituents broadly, but with business owners and stakeholder groups. Not the people who vote for them. The people who fund them.
This is what a safe seat produces. A representative who has stopped needing you. Gerrymandering is the tactic. But voters are the target. All of them.

## **What this series will show you.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/291d7e27-ac78-4ee6-92a0-d317f379f47e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Partisan Gerrymandering](https://substack.com/redirect/08fd9eaf-822b-4908-85ae-79b5e2d57acd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Over ten installments, we are going to take this apart completely -- and then show you what can actually be done about it.
**We start where the machine started. In Part 1** , we go back to 2010 -- to REDMAP, to Karl Rove's Wall Street Journal op-ed, to the $30 million that flipped 20 state legislative chambers and handed Republicans control of the mapmaking process for an entire decade. We document what Democrats were doing instead, and why that failure compounded into the structural disadvantage that persists today.
**In Part 2** , we follow the legal guardrails as they were dismantled one ruling at a time -- from _Buckley v. Valeo_ in 1976, which opened the door to unlimited political spending, through _Citizens United_ in 2010, through _Rucho v. Common Cause_ in 2019, through _Callais_ last month. Each decision narrowed the field of legal recourse available to voters. Together they closed it entirely.
**Part 3** draws the full circle -- from corporate PAC money to redistricting to policy outcomes. We show, with sourced data, what happens to healthcare legislation, wage policy, gun safety, and environmental regulation in gerrymandered states versus competitive ones. This is where the abstract becomes concrete: what rigged maps actually cost people, in dollars and in lives.
**Part 4** is the mathematics. Geographic sorting, the S-curve, the reason a 10-point national wave can produce a 5-seat swing when maps are drawn to absorb it. We draw on research from Duke, MIT, and Harvard to show how the numbers work -- and what neutral maps would have produced in Ohio and across the country.
**Part 5** covers the technology -- the same algorithmic tools that made extreme gerrymandering possible, and the open-source research tools now sitting in university labs that could draw fairer maps than any human legislature has ever produced. This is not a theoretical future. The tools exist. The question is whether voters will demand they be used.
**Part 6** maps the battlefield state by state in the post-_Callais_ world -- which states are redrawing maps right now, which seats are at risk, and what the floor looks like for Democrats trying to win a House majority against maps explicitly designed to stop them.
**Part 7** is the Ohio story in full -- redistricting history from 2010 to today, the seven court rejections, the legislature that ignored every one of them, and what the next cycle looks like if nothing changes.
**Part 8** is about solutions -- what has actually worked, in California, Virginia, Michigan, and elsewhere. Independent commissions. Algorithmic maps. Multi-member districts. The Fair Representation Act. We do not cover solutions that sound good but have no path to implementation. We cover what has moved the needle and why.
**Part 9** is the timeline -- what Democrats and reform advocates must do in the next four years, before the 2030 census resets the cycle. The 2026 Ohio Supreme Court races. The 2028 seats. The governor's race. The ballot initiative pathway. Year by year, what the window looks like and how quickly it closes.
**And Part 10** is yours. Specific, actionable, and honest about what one person can actually do -- whether you live in Ohio or not, whether you have $25 or $2,500, whether you want to donate, organize, vote in a judicial race you've never thought about before, or simply understand the fight well enough to explain it to someone else.
* * *
_**The system is rigged. That is not a talking point -- it is a documented, litigated, peer-reviewed fact. But it was not rigged against one party. It was rigged against people. Against the nurse in a county that lost its hospital. Against the factory worker whose wages haven't moved in seventeen years. Against the parent -- Republican or Democrat -- who wanted their legislature to act and watched it do nothing. Against every voter whose representative stopped showing up the moment the map made the seat safe. The coalition that can fix this is not one party. It is everyone who has noticed that their government no longer works for them. That is a very large number of people. This series is for all of them.**_

Help us keep sanity in the Senate!

| The Most Anticipated Race of 2026
Peter,
The 2026 Senate race in Maine is already making national headlines, and the stakes have never been higher.

## Grand Prairie Cancels 'Epic Eid' Event
A city-owned Grand Prairie water park [canceled](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSozAQRL8GMrlGAiEcKLjE2V56ITVII1CtQJQ0Bu_fX9m_sHFXd_V7_76mL4wp7stf3MjyK-Rpp6smYqYy0REdRe9wd5TIL1hmXIjLc1KgBgFawDh5jOln6ltvZ_B32ZKVxoyqG6Xq29WCAe3IzB3OI5huGMI9aDX4AAPqIGUb7XsMNIxSgoLuRl3Q5g7GS3fXPc5ND-Qj53LjlZheWEP6ySeVm8tbm-zKfNSm-9OoR6Me13XdQn69Kd55ox5HTpGjq416fNriQqYiDizfwq24L1TF9qwpboJO2lks-RQ4z5lZ8FoImfYqjmdKQnfwLSojk1gK7lzbYv1xxZRiHUzTw7JhTJ9f_Dubp1X_AwAA___YKIxU) plans for a June 1 "Epic Eid" event, initially promoted as "Muslims only," shortly after Gov. Greg Abbott threatened to pull $530,000 in state grants for the city on Wednesday. The city's Epic Waters Indoor Waterpark had been rented out by organizer Dr. Aminah Knight, the [owner](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGunDAQBdCvMd2szIAXKFykoXtpU6LBHsCKsZFtdh_5-oj9hddMM9LRvffP1_RFzruw_qaddfle4hT4nT2Xwmniwxl21lAw7NmulGZauaRzQolPkApkP1ly_prayupZ2qGuWNdd12PT19hWm7bP3qpWzqxMYyV23Dc9qSfiPMwKB1s5fWNSyb6uJcrmwc2iukF2tjaDamkWrWTrSkyPsnHhb8qLv-KL08PEvfJ6K-XIovklcBQ4huuIudwvgeMtCxyluk8ncDwz3P0EjjGtFNw_ThAX-Kiwn9m7HWLwF7ypcDoo_QV-cSiQzpCBYHf5YO_ZgmdKLqxgOBROYDbnraHEENMqcKyStsfbee_ysxOtXHdy_hO4_Gzml8b_AQAA___bepLH) of a local daycare, for Muslims to celebrate the holy day Eid al-Adha. While a website for the event initially advertised it as "Muslims only," it was later updated to clarify that guests would be expected to wear "modest dress only." Epic Waters opened in 2018 after voters approved a 0.25% sales tax. This year's event would have been the third time it was hosted at the water park. Despite the website's revised language stating that "all are welcome," guests were still advised to "uphold Islamic etiquette." ## Gas Power Connection Requests Surpass Wind
For the first time in a decade, applications to build gas-fired power plants in Texas [represent](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL1ygzAQhJ8GOjGS-C9UpKFz2pTMIZ3gZgQi0tnYb5-xXyH9zu5-389tvgEFOtZv2NHw08f5wCsHZMY040kWyVk4LAZ0K6QFVuR0n7XUnZCtkMPsgMJrbkpnFulGVaJRfT_oelC6KTcDiwWlGzV2i3dDh1J2sre993YBr60qybzLZCsHpaSWdYW1b_tR9k7ZsW1gKRqJjjimijdkfEL24RUfmCob9zKYjfnMRf1V6KnQ03Vd1RvBp7jzhpmBMb-ThZ4gMdmAhZ5WyOKMFyYREE6f4prFRYcTnlJmwbSjUFK8EFIWn02xJnLCxuNAyxQP8XvHO5bJuPOiECh3fdHIdQcKn1_8P5sPo_8CAAD__xLhjYw) a higher generation capacity than those to develop wind power, according to data from state grid operator ERCOT. While solar and battery projects account for 75% of the 458,000 megawatts in ERCOT's [connection queue](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykjzuOwyAUAE8DXazHz9gFxTbusu2WCMPDRsKfxThObr_KXiH9zEjzc7d3l3Jap2-3oKnPuNkVryNjrVgs7sljCt6tHjOGyZXRTVjLaTnw9gbqBp0NLuWXlTSYEULPKBqmdcdFx7iks2Fa9lx1DgQTvAelxuhZjHpsvRBaR5rMOwYKOsaAg2hQRKV70IH5Xkk3EgkYUt1KU2es-HRHzK_tgaXx20KzmWvdDyK-CB8IH67rarD4rf6eeOIbIXygxYT9Sjmno9VEwrS4lP_1-tn0w_C_AAAA___YF2qC), applications for gas projects have jumped from 12,500 megawatts to nearly 64,000 megawatts over the last three years. In the same period, applications for wind projects have increased from 25,700 to 48,000 megawatts. The shift is driven by incentives from the Texas Energy Fund (TEF) and by booming demand for data centers, which rely on 24/7 power and are often [developed](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D3OozAQxvHTmM7IHj5MChfb0GXbLZHtGchIDiDbhHD7VbLSXuCtZ_TTo_-f-3R3HHldfrsn2fKet2mlM0cqhdJEOwdiDG4NFAkXl7xbqKRjAgW9VJ1Uw4SO4zW1FVqv8KYrstqYAZpBQ1s9LMxIRg8AvZ8pBG-g6dB5M_QBO62wYvvBVKcGrRWopqZm7sxNGdTh1rXOi1YRctlSXR5U6O3yHK_tRakO27OK9lHKnkXzS8AoYDzPs050FEr5cxcw-iPzSjkLGGmltFwCxi8jt3mWS2KU-3ZSkv7giDJvLmWJrjgZaP040ifGhf69IkV3ZSkTEbP836EXMFbJ4n5yjJx7I1q1PB3H78jys7QvC38DAAD__9TmjwQ) in conjunction with power generation projects. A large portion of the 9,000 megawatts of prospective power generation projects supported by the TEF are "near-term gas projects we expect to come online," according to an ERCOT spokesperson. Meanwhile, 360,000 megawatts of power generation projects are tied to proposed data centers. "_We're going to clearly need a lot more of [gas] generation in order to have a balanced and reliable grid_ ," ERCOT CEO Pablo Vegas told a Texas Senate committee.

Greg Abbott threatened to pull $530,000 in state grants for the city on Wednesday. The city's Epic Waters Indoor Waterpark had been rented out by organizer Dr. Aminah Knight, the of a local daycare, for Muslims to celebrate the holy day Eid al-Adha. While a website for the event initially advertised it as "Muslims only," it was later updated to clarify that guests would be expected to wear "modest dress only." Epic Waters opened in 2018 after voters approved a 0.25% sales tax. This year's event would have been the third time it was hosted at the water park. Despite the website's revised language stating that "all are welcome," guests were still advised to "uphold Islamic etiquette." After Abbott the "unconstitutional" event for promoting "religious discrimination" and threatened to pull state grants for Grand Prairie, officials for the city and the water park said it would be canceled. Gas Power Connection Requests Surpass Wind For the first time in a decade, applications to build gas-fired power plants in Texas a higher generation capacity than those to develop wind power, according to data from state grid operator ERCOT. While solar and battery projects account for 75% of the 458,000 megawatts in ERCOT's , applications for gas projects have jumped from 12,500 megawatts to nearly 64,000 megawatts over the last three years. In the same period, applications for wind projects have increased from 25,700 to 48,000 megawatts. The shift is driven by incentives from the Texas Energy Fund (TEF) and by booming demand for data centers, which rely on 24/7 power and are often in conjunction with power generation projects. A large portion of the 9,000 megawatts of prospective power generation projects supported by the TEF are "near-term gas projects we expect to come online," according to an ERCOT spokesperson. Meanwhile, 360,000 megawatts of power generation projects are tied to proposed data centers. "We're going to clearly need a lot more of [gas] generation in order to have a balanced and reliable grid ," ERCOT CEO Pablo Vegas told a Texas Senate committee. A shocking new poll just dropped showing Deep State conspirator Alexander Vindman within just three points of flipping Florida in our must-win Senate special election.

The man who abused his position at the highest levels of our government, who drove the Trump impeachment from inside the National Security Council, who wasted millions of taxpayer dollars trying to bring down a duly elected president -- that man is now knocking on the door of the United States Senate. In Florida. In President Trump's home state.

Vindman has made no secret of what drives him. He's not running out of some deep love of Florida -- he just moved here! This is a man vehemently opposed to everything we stand for, singularly obsessed with destroying the America First Agenda, and determined to make every Trump supporter pay the price.

In a major upset, they flipped a Trump +11 district that includes Mar-a-Lago. National forecasters have quietly downgraded Florida from "Safe Republican," and in the last nine special elections nationwide, Democrats ran an average of 17 points higher than Kamala Harris.

They smell political blood.

Make no mistake. This race for Marco Rubio's former Senate seat is a special election - and special elections are unpredictable by nature. The normal rules don't apply. Turnout is volatile, outside money pours in fast, and a motivated opposition can flip a race that looks safe on paper. Democrats know this better than anyone. This is exactly why both Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries are going ALL IN on Florida right now.

If Vindman flips this seat, Democrats take back the Senate majority -- and nothing stands between them and another impeachment, endless obstruction, and a complete dismantling of everything we've built.

Then on Thurs, April 30th, everything changed. MAGA crossed a rubicon and did something that had never before seen in American political history:
They declared a "state of emergency", suspended our upcoming House elections, and began the process of erasing our two black districts.

Then on Thurs, April 30th, everything changed. MAGA crossed a rubicon and did something that had never before seen in American political history: They declared a "state of emergency", suspended our upcoming House elections, and began the process of erasing our two black districts. With GOP super majorities in our State House, a conservative state supreme court, and a MAGA Governor, all seemed lost. As one of the least funded parties in the nation our options were extremely limited. But then something unexpected happened. Hundreds of thousands of Democrats from across the nation began to join our ranks: | | == Our Actblue account an hour after the announcement of the Governor's decision to suspend our House election. On April 30th we all became Louisiana Democrats. Whether you were in Boulder, CO, or New Philadelphia, Ohio, our plight became a rallying cry for Democrats everywhere. In the days that followed we raised more than our party had raised in entire election cycles. Now we are headed into this fight with real firepower. We will be able launch an unprecedented counter-disinformation campaign (MAGA has convinced millions of Louisanans that the entire election has been canceled when in reality it is only the House races). And now we'll be able to fight MAGA in court with some of the best political counsel money can buy. But all of this only staunches the bleeding. The real fight ahead will be the fight to defend incumbent Congressman Cleo Fields (D-LA) the Democrat whose black majority district is in the bullseye of MAGA's Jim Crow redistricting scheme, and Congressman Troy Carter (D-LA) whose district could be next. We have to spend the next four months ensuring that these Congressman can hold out against the overwhelming odds they now likely face. A friend of mine looked at it and said, "You don't even look like the same person."

He's right. I'm not.

I'm 41 years old. I've been doing this work for twenty-two years. And every single one of those years left a mark -- not on my face, but on my spine. On my will. On the thing inside me that refuses to quit.

They tried to destroy me. They arrested me. They raided my home. They sued me. They conspired against me from the inside. They sent a former board member to the FBI to feed them information and try to put me in prison.

And I'm still here.

I was twenty-five years old. A kid with a camera and a conviction that the truth mattered more than my comfort.

Federal agents put me in handcuffs inside a United States senator's office in New Orleans. They led me out in front of the cameras. Every network in the country ran the footage. "Conservative activist arrested," the chyrons said. They wanted that to be the end of my story.

I was twenty-five. I had no money. No legal team. No powerful friends. Just a belief that citizens had a right to know what their government was doing -- and a willingness to pay the price for acting on it.

That false arrest was supposed to scare me into silence. It did the opposite. It taught me that the people in power will use every weapon they have against anyone who threatens the narrative. And it taught me that I could take the hit and keep walking. ****[KEEP JAMES AND OMG IN THE FIGHT-- DONATE NOW](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkb0OnDAQhJ_GdCD_AaZwEQnRXdqUyNgLZx32ItsQ3dtHXHRdmnS7s9-ONJpfj_lh_O7j9tME0Pbyc8pzecK7JA-uoINcEr4D7IgvM3PKu5q2NVU3xyqnresEr0Czvldc0l7y6qnVwqlZOyFXxeXKgFGrHBVOKMuBD0vl9e1EW6oYk61kjVigHezAVM_E0NGVSHoezhTIjcWYIV2m-At8jHhPGBuLodr1s5QjE_GD8InwKYM9EzQmgsNyE4RP-AJYIYDzZkt4HrcUttqaGLHUC9QLmAKxDkt94GGImM4S5oxnskDE-C-W8O5mbs8zEDF-_v5q1oTD-C0SMX4Tfi8YC8RCxGgvT3hnAp6fVbRV0u747ffd564nkm7B-P0TsPx_JZfmfwIAAP__5i-c3w)**** Eleven years later, they came for me again. This time they didn't just arrest me. They kicked in my door.

November 2021. FBI agents swarmed my apartment in New York. They put me in handcuffs in my own hallway. They seized my phones. They rifled through my belongings. A journalist -- treated like a criminal in his own home.

Why? Because someone gave us a diary that belonged to the President's daughter. We didn't publish it. We turned it over to law enforcement. **And they raided me anyway**.

"The referendum's narrow election results reinforced what Virginians decided six years ago, we don't want partisan politicians drawing our maps," said Congressman John McGuire (VA-05). "The Redistricting Commission was created to ensure all Virginians' voices are heard, and thanks to the Virginia Supreme Court, that will not change. Virginia Democrats' hasty, dishonest, and illegal attempts to redraw our maps proved how desperate they are to take away our representation. Democrat politicians in Virginia tried to cheat by violating our constitution, but thank God they didn't get away with it. I commend the Virginia Supreme Court for upholding the constitution and standing up for the voices of every voter in our Commonwealth. I want to thank everyone who worked so hard to get out the NO vote. I look forward to continuing to work with President Trump and House leadership to win the midterms, so we can continue making America great again for all Americans." | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | Most Americans think their money is safe simply because it sits in a familiar bank. | Big mistake. *As you know, America is facing a lot of major difficulties.*

Many of these have been brought on by our own leadership. Some of these
can be mitigated or exacerbated (made better or worse) for us locally by
our local leadership. With our many levels of government, including State,
County, City, School Board, etc., we have many opportunities to save our
community from the recent, mindless downhill trend of extreme Republican
base policies.

For example, our Republican Denton County Commissioners have been making
some things worse for this county. They refuse to allow vote centers on
election days in Denton County – even though state law allows them and many
Texas counties use them to make election day voting easier for voters.
They have also entered into multiple ‘287 agreements’ with federal
immigration authorities (ICE), basically deputizing Denton County law
enforcement officials as ICE agents. This hurts our communities and goes
beyond standard cooperation agreements.

*For these reasons and more, I wanted to reach out to share an opportunity
to support someone I deeply believe in: Candace Valenzuela, who is running
for Denton County Commissioner, Precinct 2.*

[image: image.jpeg]

Candace is a former at-large trustee on the Carrollton-Farmers Branch ISD
school board and a prior candidate US House. She first gained national
recognition after securing the Democratic nomination in Texas’ battleground
24th Congressional District in 2020, bringing the district to one of its
closest margins for Democrats in recent history. Since then, she has
continued her public service, including serving at the U.S. Department of
Housing and Urban Development under the Biden-Harris Administration.

[image: image.jpeg]

While this is not a congressional race, the impact of this office is
incredibly significant. As mentioned above, the Denton County Commissioners
Court is currently making decisions that directly affect some of the
county’s most vulnerable communities, including a recent 287(g) agreement
that expands ICE’s role in local law enforcement. These decisions are
happening in a county that is rapidly growing and increasingly diverse, yet
has long lacked accountability and transparency at the county level.

Candace is running to change that. She is focused on lowering costs for
families, expanding access to housing and healthcare, and ensuring local
government is serving and protecting all communities. With her background
as a school board trustee and HUD appointee, she is well-positioned to run
a competitive campaign, flip this seat, and govern effectively.

_Ad contrasts Brad Raffensperger’s focus on Georgia families with opponents’ mudslinging_
ATLANTA — Today, the Brad Raffensperger for Governor campaign released a new statewide television ad titled “Mud,” highlighting the growing contrast in the Republican primary between Brad Raffensperger’s Georgia-focused campaign and opponents spending millions attacking each other.

As Governor, I’ll focus on what actually matters: making Georgia more affordable, keeping our communities safe, and fighting for the hardworking families who make this state great.”

“Mud” is part of a broader statewide television and digital advertising effort as voters continue casting ballots during Early Voting ahead of the May 19 Republican Primary Election.

body:
Trump dodged the draft five times, and now he wants to force our honored dead into his shadow.
#
Peter, take a look at this.
[](https://act.votevets.org/signup/2600506_ARC_DE_TRUMP/?source=em260508-1-60&refcode2=35137.3013755.lkCnzu&akid=35137%2E3013755%2ElkCnzu)
That’s a mockup of the “triumphal” arch Trump wants to build in front of Arlington National Cemetery.
If you’ve ever been to Washington, you know our monuments and sacred spaces have been plotted and built over generations by thoughtful stewards of America’s heritage and history. One of the most poignant examples of that is the space between the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington National Cemetery.
[](https://act.votevets.org/signup/2600506_ARC_DE_TRUMP/?source=em260508-1-60&refcode2=35137.3013755.lkCnzu&akid=35137%2E3013755%2ElkCnzu)
From the rear steps of Lincoln’s memorial you can look directly across the Arlington Memorial Bridge to the graves of hundreds of thousands of men and women who fought and died so our democracy would survive. Donald Trump wants to block that view with a 250-foot-tall arch. A golden monument to himself. The Arc de Trump.
Just one more insult from the man who trampled the graves of the fallen at Arlington for a campaign photo op. The same man who called the fallen “suckers” and “losers,” and refused to honor them because of a little rain. **Trump dodged the draft five times, and now he wants to force our honored dead into his shadow.**
This has gone on long enough, and we must put an end to it.
[**Peter, we’re writing to ask you to voice your opposition. Veterans are already suing to block this arch, and we need to build a loud, nationwide opposition to support them. Add your name here and say no to the Arc de Trump.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/2600506_ARC_DE_TRUMP/?source=em260508-1-60&refcode2=35137.3013755.lkCnzu&akid=35137%2E3013755%2ElkCnzu)

| |
# ReproMatters

---|---
| Peter—

The trial in our case against the State of Tennessee's abortion ban exceptions has been halted indefinitely by a new Tennessee law. The longer our case is delayed, the more women and pregnant people will be harmed by this dangerous ban.

**This is not about the strength of the state's legal arguments. It is about evasion.** It is about rewriting the rules midstream to avoid accountability and prevent a public reckoning with the human cost of this ban.

As my colleague Linda Goldstein told _The Guardian_ , "The state wants to convince the people of Tennessee that the abortion ban is working and that women who need medically necessary abortion care are getting it. And what women in our case prove, and what the state is very afraid of coming to light, is that it's not working."

That's the crux of it. Because of vague and narrow medical exceptions to abortion bans, some women are being denied care, are getting infected, and are going septic. This is all because health care is criminalized, and doctors are terrified to provide standard medical treatment that they used to provide to their patients before the ban went into effect.

**This isn't about the merits; it's about access to justice.** When rules change midstream to stop a case from being heard, the stakes go far beyond Tennessee. We'll keep you updated as this case moves forward.

Marc Hearron
Senior Counsel

clean_body: Here's why it matters | | | | | ReproMatters ---|--- | Peter— The trial in our case against the State of Tennessee's abortion ban exceptions has been halted indefinitely by a new Tennessee law. The longer our case is delayed, the more women and pregnant people will be harmed by this dangerous ban. This is not about the strength of the state's legal arguments. It is about evasion. It is about rewriting the rules midstream to avoid accountability and prevent a public reckoning with the human cost of this ban. As my colleague Linda Goldstein told The Guardian , "The state wants to convince the people of Tennessee that the abortion ban is working and that women who need medically necessary abortion care are getting it. And what women in our case prove, and what the state is very afraid of coming to light, is that it's not working." That's the crux of it. Because of vague and narrow medical exceptions to abortion bans, some women are being denied care, are getting infected, and are going septic. This is all because health care is criminalized, and doctors are terrified to provide standard medical treatment that they used to provide to their patients before the ban went into effect. This isn't about the merits; it's about access to justice. When rules change midstream to stop a case from being heard, the stakes go far beyond Tennessee. We'll keep you updated as this case moves forward. Marc Hearron Senior Counsel P.S. Here's what else we're reading this week: \- Janet Koven Levit, Professor of Constitutional Law at the University of Tulsa, Guest Columnist for The Oklahoman \- Melody Schreiber, The Guardian * \- Amy Howe, SCOTUSblog | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|---|--- The Center for Reproductive Rights uses the power of law to advance reproductive rights as fundamental human rights around the world. © Center for Reproductive Rights Center for Reproductive Rights 199 Water St. New York, NY 10038 United States
