Today was a reminder that powerful people will always try to protect power, even when it comes at the expense of voters and our democracy.
They will use every threat and trick. By overturning the new maps and the will of Virginia voters, the Virginia Supreme Court today joins those who have capitulated when they had their chance to put our country and Constitution first.
That is the job of historians. My job is urgent and clear – I am going to defeat Rep. John McGuire and flip Virginia’s Fifth District. I am the only Democrat to win this district in a generation, and I am going to do it again this year, with your help. These midterms are game over or game on for our Constitution and system of checks and balances.
The people of Central and Southside Virginia cannot afford two more years of this chaos, corruption, and cruelty from Washington. Our food banks are bursting at the seams from historic levels of hunger, because of SNAP cuts and food prices. Emergency rooms are overflowing because of Medicaid cuts and premium hikes. Folks do not expect Washington to solve every problem, but they do expect their elected representatives, like McGuire, not to make their lives worse.
Our region deserves real representation. In listening sessions across our region, people on the right, left, and center agree on one thing – McGuire needs to be fired. He could have chosen to fight for our communities, but McGuire chose instead to duck and cover. He has voted to take more money out of our pockets, and refused to answer to constituents who ask him why.
Folks across Central and Southside Virginia know that I am a fighter. That I listen. And that my priority will be immediate economic relief for families across our communities. From expanding affordable healthcare to repairing the Robertson Bridge, I will focus on what brings down costs, pushes up paychecks, and forces the powerful to play by the same set of rules as the rest of us.
We are going to win this seat back for the people. I am the only Democrat in a generation to win a congressional race in Virginia's Fifth District, when I flipped the seat in 2008 against a six-term Republican incumbent.
Since launching my campaign, I have been in every corner of this district. I have sat with the farmers getting crushed by tariffs, the families choosing between groceries and gas, and the young people who wonder if home ownership has become a thing of the past. I am more determined than ever to fight for everyone to get a fair shot, and to flip this district.
I am locked in. I am ready to win this. But I need your help. If you can channel that outrage and frustration into action, please commit today to helping our campaign.
Please join my campaign today and donate whatever amount you can to help us flip this seat once and for all. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perriello-em?amount=50]

| | | | | | Hello Friends and Supporters,
With Election Day now less than six months away — and mail-in ballots going out in under five — the stakes couldn't be higher. But first things first: our **Primary Election is Tuesday, May 19th**.
There are still contested races on the Republican ballot, including for **Lt. Governor** and **U.S. Congress**. I'm proud to support two close friends in these races: **Jason Richey** for Lt. Governor and **Tony Guy** for U.S. Congress. Also on your ballot this year is the election of **Republican State Committee members** — individuals who serve four-year terms and help lead the statewide Republican Party. These seats are elected by State Senate District, and you may vote for up to three male and three female candidates.
* * *
**
Vote This Weekend — North Park Ice Rink | 10 AM–2 PM**
Don't wait until Tuesday! Allegheny County has set up early in-person satellite voting centers at select locations across the county, and **any Allegheny County voter** can cast their ballot this **Saturday (5/9) or Sunday (5/10)** at North Park Ice Rink from **10 AM to 2 PM**. You can also return your mail-in ballot there. And while you're at it — **grab a yard sign at the GOP table outside!
**
* * *
******Fundraiser — Thursday, May 28th at Wildwood Country Club**
Elections are expensive — and competitive. In 2024, I was outspent **$750,000 to $250,000** in the State House race. This year, progressive groups will likely pour in even more to try to flip our seat.
The reality is stark: with the State House currently split **102 Democrats to 101 Republicans** , there are only 10–15 truly competitive districts in the entire state. Every swing seat is a battleground — and ours is one of them.
Your continued support makes it possible for me to return to Harrisburg and keep fighting for Pennsylvania. **Thank you** to everyone who has already contributed.Details on our May 28th fundraiser are below. And if you're unable to attend, please consider making an **online donation** or mailing a check to:
**Friends of Jeremy Shaffer** P.O. Box 391 Gibsonia, PA 15044

And while you're at it — grab a yard sign at the GOP table outside! ****Fundraiser — Thursday, May 28th at Wildwood Country Club Elections are expensive — and competitive. In 2024, I was outspent $750,000 to $250,000 in the State House race. This year, progressive groups will likely pour in even more to try to flip our seat. The reality is stark: with the State House currently split 102 Democrats to 101 Republicans , there are only 10–15 truly competitive districts in the entire state. Every swing seat is a battleground — and ours is one of them. Your continued support makes it possible for me to return to Harrisburg and keep fighting for Pennsylvania. subject: Why Gina’s campaign is so important to me
body:
Texas deserves better.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260508_1_wendydavis.IEjtxl&refcode=em20260508-1079&amount=5&t=1&akid=1079%2E299639%2E7XMET8)
Peter, it’s Wendy Davis.
I’m writing today to ask for your support for my friend Gina Hinojosa’s campaign for Governor of Texas. I’ll tell you more, but if you’re already with Gina, [**can you make a $5 contribution now to support her fight against Greg Abbott?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260508_1_wendydavis.IEjtxl&refcode=em20260508-1079&amount=5&t=2&akid=1079%2E299639%2E7XMET8)
**Let me tell you a bit about why Gina’s campaign is so important to me, Peter.**
I grew up in Texas. I’ve raised my children, built a career, and made a life here.
Early on, I learned that Texas was special. That no matter where you started, you had a chance — that hard work and determination could carry you forward. That belief is what has shaped my life and everything I’ve fought for in public service.
**I’m proud to be a Texan** — but to be honest, the state I love has become harder to recognize after more than a decade of Governor Abbott’s disastrous leadership.
We’re seeing our public schools being bankrupted by Abbott’s billion dollar school voucher scam. Hospitals are closing, our electricity prices are the highest in the country, and we continue to be number one in uninsured people — including children. Communities are being left behind because Abbott is doing the bidding of his billionaire donors, rather than working to improve the lives and the opportunities of the people he was elected to serve.
Not only does Texas _deserve_ better, we can do better. We can elect Gina this year. And I know it’s possible because she’s already within 3 points of Abbott in the polls — far closer than either I or Beto ever came.
I know Gina. I’ve watched her lead. And I’ve seen exactly what she’s made of.
When her community’s schools were threatened, she didn’t wait — she stepped up and fought back to keep schools open. When Abbott pushed the agenda of the big corporations, she stood her ground and beat him again and again. And Peter, that kind of leadership really _matters_.
Gina is the person we want leading Texas. And together, we can make it happen.
But let’s not pretend this will be an easy win. I’ve run against Greg Abbott. I know how tough the fight can be when the other side has the lion’s share of power and money, and will do absolutely anything to keep it. This will be the fight of our lives.
**Gina doesn’t need to match Abbott’s $100 million dollar war chest to win — but she does need all of us standing with her and giving this everything we’ve got.**
**[If you’re ready to defeat Abbott and chart a brighter future for Texas, pitch in $5 or whatever makes sense for you. Every donation makes a difference.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260508_1_wendydavis.IEjtxl&refcode=em20260508-1079&amount=5&t=3&akid=1079%2E299639%2E7XMET8)**

Much love,
— Wendy

subject: Justin J. Pearson was on that floor

body:
Tennessee Republicans just passed one of the most brazen acts of racist voter suppression we’ve seen in decades.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260508-1&t=1&akid=3458%2E587540%2E0DixHY)
Peter,
**Tennessee Republicans just passed one of the most brazen acts of racist voter suppression we’ve seen in decades.**
Both chambers voted to carve up Tennessee’s 9th Congressional District — _the only Black-majority district in the entire state._ The district that our endorsed candidate, **State Representative Justin J. Pearson** , is currently running for.
They called a special session specifically to disenfranchise Black voters, splitting District 9 into thirds. **It’s racist, it’s anti-democratic, and it’s bullshit.**
These are the consequences of SCOTUS’ recent gutting of the Voting Rights Act in real time. Within days of the Supreme Court’s decision, Tennessee Republicans started redrawing the maps. They limited public comment, they rushed the bills through both chambers, and when Tennesseans filled the gallery to make their opposition known, state troopers removed them one by one.
Generations of Black Americans fought and marched for the right to have their voices heard in Congress. They were beaten bloody on the Edmund Pettus Bridge for it. The Voting Rights Act was a hard-fought protection, and today, Tennessee Republicans disrespected the long legacy of Black civil rights leaders as well as the voters and made it clear they no longer feel bound by anything other than their insatiable hunger for political power.
Leaders We Deserve endorsed-candidate **Justin J. Pearson** was on the floor fighting like hell for his district. He spoke truth to power, and called these maps exactly what they are: _“Racist tools of white supremacy at the behest of the most powerful white supremacist in the United States of America, Donald J. Trump.”_
The district Justin is running to represent — the one that has given Black Memphians a voice in Congress for over half a century — is being erased out of existence. Tennessee’s Republican Governor signed the new maps into law yesterday.
This is a moment where the work we do at Leaders We Deserve is mission critical. The only real answer to a system that keeps finding new ways to silence Black voters is to put everything we’ve got behind the leaders who refuse to be silenced and make it clear that _this movement isn’t going anywhere._
**We are deeply proud to back Justin J. Pearson.** The resilience, conviction, and moral courage he showed in that Chamber is exactly what makes him the kind of generational leader who will be remembered long after this dark chapter in American democracy.

Thank you,
David Hogg

name: Gary Sinise, American Veterans Center
subject: As America turns 250, we must honor them while we can
body:
The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans.

| | |
---
Friend,
---
It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. clean_body: The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. | | | Friend, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Friend, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Friend, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Friend, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honarary Grand MarshalNational Memorial Day Parade P.S. Friend, America is stepping into its 250th year, and this Memorial Day begins that national remembrance. Veterans across generations have given their lives to defend America and all she stands for. And for the Greatest Generation in particular, this may be the last time they're able to join us at this year's National Memorial Day Parade. There's no better send-off we can give them than to make sure they're present to honor their fallen brethren during America's 250th birthday. body:
https://www.everyaction.com/ [https://www.everyaction.com/]
Weekly Montgomery
Volunteer Round-Up
46 Days Until the Primary Election
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109172/images/20260502_165030%20Medium.jpeg]
Door Knocking
Wednesday, May 13th, 10 AM - 12 PM
Before you head to the Meet and Greet, help knock doors around Gaithersburg! We'll be heading out to engage with voters, share the positive work happening in our district, and get people excited to re-elect Congresswoman April McClain Delaney.
Whether you have canvassed 1000 times or 0 times, this is a great chance to get involved with the campaign! We will begin with a quick training session before heading out, and go out in pairs; no experience is necessary!
Bring comfortable shoes, water, and whatever attire the weather dictates! It'll be a great day of conversation and community as we work towards re-electing Congresswoman Delaney. We can't wait to see you there!
Sign Up Here [https://www.mobilize.us/aprilmcclaindelaneyforcongress/event/951059/]
Saturday, May 16th, 1 PM - 3 PM
Come out on Saturday, May 16th to knock some doors in Poolesville from 1–3 PM! Knocking doors is a great way to help support the campaign, talk to voters, and get folks excited to vote!
We will begin with a quick training session and send people out in pairs , so whether you've canvassed 1,000 times or 0 times, come on out!
Wear comfortable shoes and whatever clothes the weather dictates.
Sign Up Here [https://www.mobilize.us/aprilmcclaindelaneyforcongress/event/952088/]
(Virtual) Phone Banks
Thursday Night Phone Banks Sign Up [https://www.mobilize.us/aprilmcclaindelaneyforcongress/event/934939/]
Every Thursday night, 6-8 PM , until Election Night, we will have a virtual and in-person phone bank to turn out supporters and recruit more volunteers!
Either come on into the office or join from the comfort of your own home .
All you need is a phone and the willingness to make some calls. Hope to see you there!
Tuesday Night Phone Banks Sign Up [https://www.mobilize.us/aprilmcclaindelaneyforcongress/event/936896/]
Every Tuesday night, 6-8 PM, until Election Night, we will have a virtual phone bank, with an in-person option in Frederick coming soon. Help turn out supporters and grow our volunteer base!
Join from the comfort of your own home.
Gaithersburg Office Volunteering
Tuesday - Friday, 10 AM - 6 PM, Every Week
Join us at the campaign office to help re-elect Congresswoman April McClain Delaney! Our office is open Tuesday - Friday from 10 AM to 6 PM, and volunteers can jump in however they’d like—whether that’s knocking doors, making phone calls, or helping with important office projects that keep the campaign running.
You’re welcome to pop in for an hour or stay longer, whatever fits your schedule. We just ask that you sign up ahead of time so we can make sure we have materials, lists, and snacks ready for you. It’s a great way to meet fellow supporters, build community, and make a real impact in the campaign .
Sign Up Here [https://www.mobilize.us/aprilmcclaindelaneyforcongress/event/942348/]
Donations
Help Power This Campaign Donation Photo [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109172/images/4.14.24%20newsletter/IMG_9151%202%20%283%29.jpg]
We need your support to re-elect April to Congress! Any donation makes a world of difference.
Chip in Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/delaney-website?refcode=main-donate-link]
Best Regards, [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109172/images/IMG_0045.jpeg]

She has built a record of delivering real results, from improving our 9-1-1 centers, advancing election reform, protecting consumers at the gas pump, to supporting the nonprofit organizations serving our community. She is a longtime friend and a true partner in Annapolis. Cheryl understands what it takes to lead, solve problems, and get things done. Her support speaks volumes about the strength of what we’re building together. This endorsement is about more than one person. It’s about the growing coalition behind this campaign and our shared commitment to practical, results-driven leadership. = | | = | = | = | = | = | = | = From career and volunteer firefighters, to retired teachers, to elected leaders at the federal, state, and local levels, and community, nonprofit, labor and business leaders, this campaign is bringing together people from every corner of Montgomery County. It reflects a shared belief that Montgomery County needs a new direction with new leadership, focused on lowering costs and delivering real results for our community. All the momentum is on our side. Let’s keep it going! Together, = * | | = By Authority: Friends of Andrew Friedson, Rose Hacking, Treasurer Friends of Andrew Friedson PO Box 2562 Rockville, MD 20847 United States | =

Friend, Last night, we officially kicked off our re-election campaign with hundreds of supporters – and I have to say, seeing that many people come together was pretty incredible. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131038113/619722244/846650056?refcode=em-5.8.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDE2OTE4MC0xODRiLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ka_9rjxmOWOSwR6Dw4tpmnZURjk0Hko78U9XfnOkDdw=) We’re starting this campaign the same way we started the last one – by bringing people together who are ready to organize, ready to fight for working families, and ready to win one of the toughest races in the country. We won by directly talking to our neighbors and shining a spotlight on the very real struggles people face every day – housing costs, child care, prescription drugs, and the erosion of our fundamental rights. That’s why we were _one of only _three__ non-incumbent House Democrats to win in a district carried by Donald Trump. body:
This is the latest news.
| I'm emailing you more motivated than ever before.

**Republicans passed their racist, outrageous gerrymandered districts in Tennessee that eliminate District 9 as the only majority-Black and majority-Democratic district in our state.**

They have cheated their way into a map that favors Republicans, where politicians are picking their voters instead of voters picking their leaders.

We need to call this what it is: **this new map is a political lynching** — an affront to justice and the fight for equality.

My heart aches for my hometown of Memphis, where I was born and raised and where generations of my family are buried. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109016?t=6&akid=24238%2E878179%2EsJZlWP) **But I refuse to give in to despair. Don't give up hope.** The fight still carries on, renewed with urgency as we work to restore the rights that our ancestors marched, prayed, bled, and died for.

[This righteous fight for our rights has never been more important, to push back against Jim Crow 2.0, to end the corruption that runs rampant and free, to give Black and Brown People a true voice in their democracy. Our fight continues: Will you please split a donation of $10 right away between me and the Voter Protection Project to stand against authoritarianism?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109016?t=7&akid=24238%2E878179%2EsJZlWP) | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109016?t=8&akid=24238%2E878179%2EsJZlWP)

Republicans have taken the only Black-majority district from us. But I want you to know: No matter what they do, no matter how much they try to break us and make us bend and quit — **we will still be here.**

I'm still going to fight to demonstrate strong leadership in TN, and I hope that you, as a member of this People-powered Movement, are still by my side.

This isn't over, and we will not stop until justice rolls down like waters and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream. [Will you split $10 or more in the next 30 minutes to fight this authoritarian power grab? »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109016?t=9&akid=24238%2E878179%2EsJZlWP)

clean_body: Republicans could call a constitutional convention without a single Democratic vote | = Peter, We know Republicans are working to destroy our fundamental freedoms from every angle. They're banning abortion, attacking IVF, and, based on rumblings from certain Republican-controlled legislatures, coming for birth control next. They're radically reshaping our courts and destroying our federal workforce. They're flouting foundational American ideals in order to fashion the current president into an unstoppable tyrant. They've made it clear, in other words, that their goal is to attack the very root of what defines America. And there's one plan of attack that doesn't get enough attention: The Republican plot to rewrite the U.S. Constitution. You read that right: If the GOP controls enough state legislatures, they can call a constitutional convention and rewrite our country's founding document. = | = Republicans have been working for decades to overwhelm state legislatures and rewrite the rules to ensure they stay in power at all costs. 28 states have already pledged to call for a constitutional convention, which means Republicans need to convince just SIX more to enshrine their anti-choice, anti-democracy ideas into our Constitution. I'm here to tell you we won't let that happen. We've been working to build governing majorities in critical states for decades, because we know that state legislatures are vital in protecting our rights. This cycle is no different: we have strong Democratic pro-choice women running at the state level in 2026. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Let them call me shrill, dumb, inexperienced, girly, uneducated
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
these folks will say anything to distract from or undercut the truth that working people are getting screwed
#
The single largest form of theft in America is wage theft. $50 billion a year are stolen from American workers.
If a billionaire amasses their wealth by underpaying their full-time workers so severely that they must rely on food assistance and government programs to survive, then no, that wealth was not earned by one individual — it was a wealth transfer subsidized by underpaid American workers and the public who get stuck with the bill for large corporations free-riding off our systems.
The point is less about individual morality. It’s more about how our current economic reality of shattering inequality rewards screwing over workers and exploiting essential systems at scale.
We’re talking monopoly power. Rent-seeking. Wage theft. Profiteering. Stock buybacks. Destabilizing housing markets. Companies using SNAP/EBT to underwrite their wages. Massive government subsidies or contracts to corporations following lobbying and dark money in politics with little to no oversight or accountability.
Some people get enraged that I draw attention to this. That’s on them.
Let them call me shrill, dumb, inexperienced, girly, uneducated — these folks will say anything to distract from or undercut the truth that working people are getting screwed, and giving people a fair shake means we must have a grown conversation about reigning in abuse of power.
Oligarchy or democracy. But we cannot have both. We choose to out-organize the oligarchy.
[I am committed to fighting for a democracy that works for all, not just a wealthy few. Help us continue the fight with a grassroots contribution today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260508.7ui11P&refcode=em20260508-11375-P_FND_EXP_TWT&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=11375%2E2526796%2EQIlhQa)

But if we stand side-by-side, lock arms, and persist, we can fight back and elect representatives who will make life more affordable and defend our freedoms. But we can’t just talk the talk about this being the most important election of our lifetimes. We have to do our part to back it up.

name: Forward Party
subject: Americans Are Feeling the Squeeze. Washington Must Do Better.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Forward Party and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Americans are anxious about the economy. People feel it every time they buy groceries, fill up their gas tank, pay rent, or open a credit card bill.

| | | [ ](www.forwardparty.com)
---
### Peter —
Americans are anxious about the economy. People feel it every time they buy groceries, fill up their gas tank, pay rent, or open a credit card bill. Across the country, families are asking the same question: why does it feel harder and harder to get ahead, even when they are working harder than ever?

New polling from Gallup shows affordability now dominates Americans’ financial worries. Inflation and high prices remain the top concern for families, while a record 55% of Americans say their financial situation is getting worse. Energy costs, housing costs, healthcare expenses, transportation, and childcare are all rising faster than many household budgets can keep up with.

At the same time, confidence in the broader economy is falling sharply. Gallup’s Economic Confidence Index dropped to -38 in April, one of the lowest readings in recent years and a sign that Americans are increasingly pessimistic about both current conditions and where the economy is heading. Even among people who are still employed and financially stable, anxiety about the future is growing. Americans are worried about layoffs, AI, inflation, debt, and whether the next generation will have the same opportunities they had.

There are warning signs at the national level as well. This week, America’s debt burden surpassed the country’s annual economic output for the first time since World War II, with public debt reaching more than $31 trillion. Economists across the political spectrum increasingly warn that long-term fiscal dysfunction in Washington is making it harder to invest in the future while also increasing pressure on interest rates and the cost of living.

And yet, despite these very real concerns, too much of our political system remains trapped in partisan theater instead of focused on practical solutions. Americans are looking for leadership willing to address affordability, energy costs, housing supply, workforce development, healthcare expenses, and the national debt with seriousness and honesty. Instead, many see constant political warfare, performative outrage, and a system designed more around scoring points than solving problems.

This is where Forward’s values matter.

The Forward Party was built around the belief that Americans are exhausted by a politics that rewards division and punishes problem solving. Most voters are not asking for ideological purity. They are asking for leaders who will listen, work together, use facts and data, and focus on outcomes that improve everyday life.

Forward believes affordability should not be a partisan issue. Making it easier to build housing, supporting energy innovation, investing in workforce training for a changing economy, modernizing infrastructure, and bringing down healthcare costs are not red or blue ideas. They are practical challenges that require serious leadership.

Forward also believes the country cannot solve long-term economic problems if elected officials are more focused on protecting political power than building public trust. Gerrymandered districts, hyper-partisan primaries, and a political culture driven by outrage make compromise politically risky even when compromise is what the country needs most.

But there is reason for optimism.

Across the country, more independent and solutions-focused leaders are stepping forward to run for office, build coalitions, and challenge the idea that Americans are permanently stuck choosing between dysfunction and extremism. Voters are increasingly open to candidates who prioritize collaboration, accountability, and results over partisan loyalty.

The economic challenges facing the country are real. Americans feel them every day. But this moment also creates an opportunity to rethink how we govern and what we reward in politics.

The future does not have to be defined by gridlock, economic anxiety, and political exhaustion. With better leadership, more accountability, and a political system that rewards solving problems instead of escalating conflict, the country can build an economy that is more affordable, more resilient, and more hopeful for the next generation. **Please forward this to your friends, family, and coworkers. It helps us introduce them to Forward and to what we are building. Also consider inviting them to one of our upcoming events listed below. We'd love to meet them.**

clean_body: Americans are anxious about the economy. People feel it every time they buy groceries, fill up their gas tank, pay rent, or open a credit card bill. | | | www.forwardparty.com Peter — Americans are anxious about the economy. People feel it every time they buy groceries, fill up their gas tank, pay rent, or open a credit card bill. Across the country, families are asking the same question: why does it feel harder and harder to get ahead, even when they are working harder than ever? New polling from Gallup shows affordability now dominates Americans’ financial worries. Inflation and high prices remain the top concern for families, while a record 55% of Americans say their financial situation is getting worse. Energy costs, housing costs, healthcare expenses, transportation, and childcare are all rising faster than many household budgets can keep up with. At the same time, confidence in the broader economy is falling sharply. Gallup’s Economic Confidence Index dropped to -38 in April, one of the lowest readings in recent years and a sign that Americans are increasingly pessimistic about both current conditions and where the economy is heading. Even among people who are still employed and financially stable, anxiety about the future is growing. Americans are worried about layoffs, AI, inflation, debt, and whether the next generation will have the same opportunities they had. There are warning signs at the national level as well. This week, America’s debt burden surpassed the country’s annual economic output for the first time since World War II, with public debt reaching more than $31 trillion. Economists across the political spectrum increasingly warn that long-term fiscal dysfunction in Washington is making it harder to invest in the future while also increasing pressure on interest rates and the cost of living. And yet, despite these very real concerns, too much of our political system remains trapped in partisan theater instead of focused on practical solutions. Americans are looking for leadership willing to address affordability, energy costs, housing supply, workforce development, healthcare expenses, and the national debt with seriousness and honesty. Instead, many see constant political warfare, performative outrage, and a system designed more around scoring points than solving problems. This is where Forward’s values matter. The Forward Party was built around the belief that Americans are exhausted by a politics that rewards division and punishes problem solving. Most voters are not asking for ideological purity. They are asking for leaders who will listen, work together, use facts and data, and focus on outcomes that improve everyday life. Forward believes affordability should not be a partisan issue. Making it easier to build housing, supporting energy innovation, investing in workforce training for a changing economy, modernizing infrastructure, and bringing down healthcare costs are not red or blue ideas. They are practical challenges that require serious leadership. Forward also believes the country cannot solve long-term economic problems if elected officials are more focused on protecting political power than building public trust. Gerrymandered districts, hyper-partisan primaries, and a political culture driven by outrage make compromise politically risky even when compromise is what the country needs most. But there is reason for optimism. Across the country, more independent and solutions-focused leaders are stepping forward to run for office, build coalitions, and challenge the idea that Americans are permanently stuck choosing between dysfunction and extremism. Voters are increasingly open to candidates who prioritize collaboration, accountability, and results over partisan loyalty. The economic challenges facing the country are real. Americans feel them every day. But this moment also creates an opportunity to rethink how we govern and what we reward in politics. The future does not have to be defined by gridlock, economic anxiety, and political exhaustion. With better leadership, more accountability, and a political system that rewards solving problems instead of escalating conflict, the country can build an economy that is more affordable, more resilient, and more hopeful for the next generation. **I want to reach as many people as I can with this request...**

clean_body: The next week is a crucial time for Chris and Summer to reach as many voters as possible. | | | Friend, I’m proud to endorse Chris Rabb, a five-term state representative running for Congress in Pennsylvania to make transformative changes that working families need. And his Democratic primary is just 11 days away! When endorsing him, the Philadelphia Inquirer wrote that he has “consistently offered the boldest and most ambitious leadership” in this race. Like me and Congresswoman Summer Lee, Chris Rabb wants to stop Israel’s genocide in Gaza and identifies as a Democratic Socialist. We’re building a government that answers to the people, not billionaires and corporate lobbyists. That makes us targets: AIPAC is funding one of Chris Rabb’s opponents and has spent millions trying to unseat Summer Lee. One of my opponents has a history of taking money from corporate polluters and big banks. In contrast, Summer, Chris, and I rely on grassroots donations. Funding is especially essential now, because Summer and Chris only have a week and a half left to reach voters before their primary elections on May 19. | ** The first Black woman elected to Congress from Pennsylvania, Congresswoman Summer Lee (next to me in the above photo) has also endorsed Chris. So have many members of our Squad and leaders of the Congressional Progressive Caucus. Chris said, “Centrism is not going to save us. We need real change, not another status quo politician who gives us more of the same.” That’s why Chris, Summer, and I are fighting for Medicare for All, abolishing ICE, universal basic income and childcare, ending wars, expanding public services such as housing and food assistance, living wages, reparations for Black Americans, accountability for police, and environmental justice. We’re all supported by deeply progressive organizations such as the Working Families Party, Democratic Socialists of America groups, and Justice Democrats. Meanwhile, one of Chris Rabb’s opponents worked with Republicans to push a gerrymandered district map for personal gain, and wants to keep sending weapons and money to Israel’s military. Summer, Chris, and I are fighting for a government that represents and is aligned with the American people. We’re all running to represent heavily Democratic districts, so whoever wins in their primary elections is very likely to go on to serve in Congress next year. That means for Chris and Summer, the next week and a half is a crucial time for them to reach as many voters as possible. subject: You won’t believe who’s running against Ilhan
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20260508-2240-foote&t=1001&akid=2240%2E342411%2Eb40Z1P ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter, earlier
this year, Trump unleashed ICE into Minnesota — and the consequences
ripped through communities.

Families were separated. Neighborhoods were destabilized. People lived
with fear that didn’t fade when the headlines did. Even now, the harm is
still present in the daily lives of working families who were forced to
carry it.

And now, a former ICE prosecutor is running to challenge Ilhan’s seat in
Congress. This is a direct attempt to bring the same enforcement-first,
punishment-driven mindset into a seat that our progressive champion has
spent her career fighting back against.

Ilhan has never wavered. She’s protecting immigrant families, pushing back
against cruelty dressed up as policy, and holding her ground. She’s
refusing to back down from speaking truth to power and saying what too
many in Washington won’t.

And now she’s being targeted by someone who helped enforce the very system
she’s been fighting to change.

We have one thing to say: we’re not going backwards.

The Squad Victory Fund is mobilizing right now to defend her seat —
organizing with voters, strengthening grassroots infrastructure, and
making sure people understand exactly what’s at stake before the primary
hits full force.

Because this isn’t just about one campaign. It’s about whether communities
like the ones in Minnesota are represented by people who will stand up for
them or by people who once carried out policies that tore those
communities apart.

subject: She thought it was her only option
body:
But the moment she allowed herself to slow down, even just for a second, something didn’t sit right.

| | | | [](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcGqnjAQhZ9m3PkTJ5rkX7i4IK5qob2FLiXGUUNNIkm8l__ti8U-wF3OnMP5mDm_h3HQdrd-_a4dtTEvY0xj2ihv4Vy3bPOnThvF4PdXOPKIDEXJmpKpy1cVczubWVemoLaSUqGsmayLrUWuNGuekibdqAmrWlbTc1mkXNRTPQ0Vtr2iWMMUVqxi4lFLIVXN64qLZZKqgZrpnWJ-RDrOabdG-6zTnyVEQw8TXLG3W85HAv4G2AP2q_2gxxFpCtFfBsD-ngB7F_JGMZWzfgHvkwHeDd0ba1C8D-_fAIV2GXiHClCsCXinPaA4sxtTOKMh4N0RQzrIZOvXW3I029MB78hpu99Lo92h7eqBdzf0Yt5a8Jn8BRpw_CHLn7_68v8bitjOx6fdd5uEhJqtV-a_Q_PXa_lo8W8AAAD__1Kzmr4)
---
Friend of Life, Katrina had already made up her mind, or at least that is what she kept telling herself as everything around her reinforced the idea that abortion was the only realistic option, the simplest path forward, the decision she just needed to get through so she could move on with her life. But the moment she allowed herself to slow down, even just for a second, something didn’t sit right. She described it as a heaviness that wouldn’t go away, a quiet but persistent feeling that going through with the abortion didn’t match what she truly wanted, even though she felt like she didn’t have any other choice. She kept thinking, _What if I’m making a mistake? What if I can’t undo this?_ But she didn’t know if she could change course. She didn’t know if it was already too late. In the middle of that uncertainty, she found her way to a PreBorn! Network Clinic, where for the first time no one rushed her, no one pressured her to go through with an abortion, and no one treated her like a decision that needed to be finalized quickly. Instead, she was given space to breathe, to think, and to understand what was actually happening. And then she was offered an ultrasound. [**When the screen lit up and she saw her baby, everything she had been trying to push aside came into focus.**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcGqnjAQhZ9m3PkTJ5rkX7i4IK5qob2FLiXGUUNNIkm8l__ti8U-wF3OnMP5mDm_h3HQdrd-_a4dtTEvY0xj2ihv4Vy3bPOnThvF4PdXOPKIDEXJmpKpy1cVczubWVemoLaSUqGsmayLrUWuNGuekibdqAmrWlbTc1mkXNRTPQ0Vtr2iWMMUVqxi4lFLIVXN64qLZZKqgZrpnWJ-RDrOabdG-6zTnyVEQw8TXLG3W85HAv4G2AP2q_2gxxFpCtFfBsD-ngB7F_JGMZWzfgHvkwHeDd0ba1C8D-_fAIV2GXiHClCsCXinPaA4sxtTOKMh4N0RQzrIZOvXW3I029MB78hpu99Lo92h7eqBdzf0Yt5a8Jn8BRpw_CHLn7_68v8bitjOx6fdd5uEhJqtV-a_Q_PXa_lo8W8AAAD__1Kzmr4) She wasn’t just trying to “get through something” anymore. She was looking at her child. And in that moment, her decision changed. The abortion she thought was certain no longer felt that way. Today, Katrina is a mom, holding the baby she once believed she might lose. That is the power of one moment. Right now, there are women in that same place, feeling that same pressure to move forward with an abortion, asking those same questions, and wondering if they have any other option. $28 provides one ultrasound. [**Would you help give her the chance to see before she decides?**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcGqnjAQhZ9m3PkTJ5rkX7i4IK5qob2FLiXGUUNNIkm8l__ti8U-wF3OnMP5mDm_h3HQdrd-_a4dtTEvY0xj2ihv4Vy3bPOnThvF4PdXOPKIDEXJmpKpy1cVczubWVemoLaSUqGsmayLrUWuNGuekibdqAmrWlbTc1mkXNRTPQ0Vtr2iWMMUVqxi4lFLIVXN64qLZZKqgZrpnWJ-RDrOabdG-6zTnyVEQw8TXLG3W85HAv4G2AP2q_2gxxFpCtFfBsD-ngB7F_JGMZWzfgHvkwHeDd0ba1C8D-_fAIV2GXiHClCsCXinPaA4sxtTOKMh4N0RQzrIZOvXW3I029MB78hpu99Lo92h7eqBdzf0Yt5a8Jn8BRpw_CHLn7_68v8bitjOx6fdd5uEhJqtV-a_Q_PXa_lo8W8AAAD__1Kzmr4)

Headline: 85 Percent of Voters Want Congress to Pass the Equal Rights Amendment [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/ERA_Poll.png]
Fifty years after the Equal Rights Amendment (ERA) was initially passed in Congress, an overwhelming majority of likely voters want the provision aimed at guaranteeing equal rights for all genders to go into effect .
Recent polling from Data for Progress finds that 85 percent of likely voters support Congress passing the ERA to give it a second chance at being adopted as a constitutional amendment. Support for the amendment is bipartisan, with 93 percent of Democrats and 79 percent of both independents and Republicans agreeing that the provision should be passed.
We want to hear from voters in your area to get their feelings on the topic. Will you take our one-question poll right away?

I'm going to tell you something most candidates won't say out loud...
**I lost.**

#### **[I'll get into it more below, but I've learned not to wait on the ask -- because the truth is, this campaign lives or dies on whether grassroots supporters like you are behind us. Dark money is moving fast. We have to move faster. So please, chip in $5 or $10 to help me win in 2026:](https://substack.com/redirect/6c33fd44-2858-4e85-89fe-9c9bfbe94267?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[JOIN THE FIGHT](https://substack.com/redirect/6c33fd44-2858-4e85-89fe-9c9bfbe94267?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In 2024, I ran for Congress in Maryland. I fought as hard as I knew how. I knocked on doors, made calls, and connected with voters.
The voters who heard my message? They were with me.
_The problem was getting heard at all._
Dark money donors spent MILLIONS of dollars to drown me out, and it worked. I watched it happen in real time -- ads I couldn't match, mailers I couldn't answer, and a wall of money between me and the voters I was trying to reach.
When you have that kind of money, you don't have to win the argument. You just have to make sure the other side can't be heard.
I could've walked away. God knows it would've been easier.
But I filed to run again.
**I stood inside the United States Capitol on January 6th and watched Donald Trump 's mob try to tear our democracy apart with their bare hands. I held the line that day. I testified. I fought back with everything I had.**
And I'll be damned if I let dark money and MAGA intimidation knock me down.
I'm running for this district, for this state, and for the idea that our democracy is worth defending even when it's hard. Especially when it's hard.
That means standing up to Donald Trump. It means standing up to the billionaires and the PACs and the anonymous money that's quietly buying our elections out from under us.
_It means being exactly the kind of elected official that corporate donors are spending all that money to keep out._
#### **[But look, if I'm going to compete with the billionaires and come out on top, I need grassroots Democrats like you on my team. Can I count on you to chip in a few dollars to my people-powered campaign today?](https://substack.com/redirect/6c33fd44-2858-4e85-89fe-9c9bfbe94267?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Let's do this,
Harry

I’m grateful. Truly.

**I came off the sidelines for one reason: Ohio families.**

Life is too expensive. Paychecks are too low. Costs are too high – utilities, health care, groceries, everything.

Ohioans see more money going out the door, and not enough money coming in.

And it’s because the system is rigged. Too many Ohioans are getting the short end of the stick while people in power are doing favors for billionaires and corporate special interests. You are working harder than ever, but you can’t get ahead.

But instead of working to bring down costs and taking on corporate interests, politicians in Washington are making things worse. Politicians like Jon Husted.

Ohio deserves better and Ohioans are showing up and insisting on change. My nomination was an important step in that fight because it brought us one step closer to flipping this seat and retaking Senate control.

**But we also know this battleground race is about to get harder.**

A new poll shows me down by 3 points. National Republicans are pouring $81 million into Ohio to defeat us – more than they’re spending in any other battleground state. And Jon Husted’s super PAC just launched a seven-figure ad buy attacking me.

**They know Ohio is in play. They know we can win. And they know that if we do, we can flip the Senate.**

_The Cook Political Report_ now calls this race a “Toss Up.” That matters. So does the grassroots energy we’ve built together.

clean_body: Time to get to work = It's official: I’m the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Ohio. I’m grateful. Truly. = | | = I came off the sidelines for one reason: Ohio families. Life is too expensive. Paychecks are too low. Costs are too high – utilities, health care, groceries, everything. Ohioans see more money going out the door, and not enough money coming in. And it’s because the system is rigged. Too many Ohioans are getting the short end of the stick while people in power are doing favors for billionaires and corporate special interests. You are working harder than ever, but you can’t get ahead. But instead of working to bring down costs and taking on corporate interests, politicians in Washington are making things worse. Politicians like Jon Husted. Ohio deserves better and Ohioans are showing up and insisting on change. My nomination was an important step in that fight because it brought us one step closer to flipping this seat and retaking Senate control. But we also know this battleground race is about to get harder. A new poll shows me down by 3 points. National Republicans are pouring $81 million into Ohio to defeat us – more than they’re spending in any other battleground state. And Jon Husted’s super PAC just launched a seven-figure ad buy attacking me. They know Ohio is in play. They know we can win. And they know that if we do, we can flip the Senate. The Cook Political Report now calls this race a “Toss Up.” That matters. So does the grassroots energy we’ve built together. **As a member of the Agriculture Committee, I'm disappointed by the Republican-controlled House's passage of the latest Farm Bill that fails to meet the moment.**

Right now, farmers across Central and Southern Illinois are facing growing uncertainty as prices rise across the board, from fertilizer to fuel. This is a direct result of the President’s failed tariff policy and war in Iran.

The farm bill failed to provide the relief our growers need. Not to mention it locked in $187 BILLION in cuts to food assistance and failed to invest in agricultural research programs we need to prepare for the future.

I voted no. And in recent days, I held a roundtable meeting of my bipartisan Agriculture Advisory Council to hear directly from the family farmers, producers, and other stakeholders affected.

Farming is synonymous with our way of life, and the people who spend day and night feeding us deserve so much better. **[I'm going to keep fighting for progress – and I hope you're with me.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131042025/619735001/-1967985835?refcode=em-5.8.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMTlhMjg5OC0yMTRiLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mLJMwbYu635ksVSsJfqWQ6z-fjIKvCegVFBjbwhmlpg=)**

**Peter, we just got some devastating news.** The Virginia Supreme Court just struck down the state’s new map that the majority of Virginian voters approved last month. This ruling is a massive gift to Donald Trump and Republicans across the country who have spent the last nine months conducting a shameless power grab through mid-cycle redraws. Meanwhile, in the wake of last week’s Supreme Court ruling that gutted the Voting Rights Act, states across the South are rapidly redrawing their maps, deliberately and systematically diminishing Black voting power. The Republican power grab is absolutely relentless — and their plan to avoid the will of the American people this November just might work. **This is shaping up to be a catastrophe for representative democracy in America. clean_body: This is a massive gift to Republicans and their national power grab. | Peter, we just got some devastating news. The Virginia Supreme Court just struck down the state’s new map that the majority of Virginian voters approved last month. This ruling is a massive gift to Donald Trump and Republicans across the country who have spent the last nine months conducting a shameless power grab through mid-cycle redraws. Meanwhile, in the wake of last week’s Supreme Court ruling that gutted the Voting Rights Act, states across the South are rapidly redrawing their maps, deliberately and systematically diminishing Black voting power. The Republican power grab is absolutely relentless — and their plan to avoid the will of the American people this November just might work. This is shaping up to be a catastrophe for representative democracy in America. But this isn’t over. The fair maps movement is already fighting back fiercely, using every resource and tool at our disposal. Today, the Supreme Court of Virginia struck down a new congressional map that Virginia voters approved just last month to fight back against the Trump-backed Republican redistricting schemes across the country.
This decision overturns the will of millions of Virginians and denies voters their Constitutional right to participate fully in our democracy. It is undemocratic, disgraceful, and deeply troubling.
DONATE TO FIGHT BACK [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260508?refcode=lpfe260508]
We knew things would get harder after the Supreme Court’s decision in Louisiana v. Callais , which struck down Louisiana’s Congressional map and gutted Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act . And now, we are seeing the consequences play out in real time.
From Texas to Tennessee to Florida, Republicans are diluting the voices of minority voters and communities, rigging congressional maps to cling to power. They know they cannot win with their policies that are utterly failing: not lowering costs, improving lives, or delivering results for families.
But as I’ve said before, when the courts step back, it is up to all of us to step forward. Every one of us must continue organizing, advocating, and building the coalitions necessary to defend our democracy and protect the right of every American to be heard.
The work to win back the House majority just got harder but it can be done. And it has to be done.
And, as you know, that work takes resources. That is why I am asking for your help today.
Please consider making a contribution so we can continue fighting back against these redistricting schemes in Texas and across the country, recruit and train the next generation of leaders, and help Democrats compete in the must-win races that will decide our future. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260508?refcode=lpfe260508]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260508?refcode=lpfe260508]
This moment is a setback—but it is not the end of the story. When we come together, organize, and stay focused, we can protect the promise of our democracy and ensure every voice is heard.
Together we can do anything,

Hey folks,
I had to talk about this one because the story is just too outrageous to ignore. Politico dropped a report this week suggesting Trump and Senate Republicans are actively trying to flip John Fetterman -- and not subtly. We're talking about promises of money, power, protection, the whole Washington playbook. And honestly? It says everything about how rotten this system has become.
This video gets into why Democrats cannot afford to be naive about what's happening right now -- and why building a _Fetterman-proof_ Senate majority matters so much heading into the midterms.
**Here are some moments you don 't want to miss:**
* [**00:01:06**] We break down why Republicans are suddenly terrified about losing the Senate -- and why Fetterman could become their insurance policy.
* [**00:02:21**] The "financial windfall" detail drops, and we get into what that actually means in modern American politics.
* [**00:04:36**] A deeper look at the relationships pulling Fetterman closer to Republican power players behind the scenes.
* [**00:06:15**] I react to Fetterman defending Trump's agenda and accusing Democrats of "Trump Derangement Syndrome."
* [**00:10:38**] The bigger takeaway: why Democrats need 52 Senate seats -- not 51 -- if we actually want to stop Trump's agenda.

At the core of this conversation is a bigger question about corruption, loyalty, and whether either party is willing to stand up to the billionaire-driven machine that keeps rewarding bad behavior. This isn't just about one senator. It's about whether Democrats are prepared for the fights ahead -- and whether we're willing to build a coalition strong enough to survive the defections, pressure campaigns, and backroom deals that are absolutely coming.
If you value blunt, honest conversations like this -- the kind that don't sugarcoat what we're up against -- help us keep building this thing together.

--Mike

**Do you have a sec to chat with me over the phone? 📞**

— Sarah

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: AIPAC is hiring in Seattle
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Today is the filing deadline to run for office here in Washington.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260508-6224-footer&t=1&akid=6224%2E420207%2EGGZx6G)
Hi Peter, it's Pramila.
Today is the filing deadline — and yes, the paperwork is in! **I’m officially running for re-election** to continue fighting for Seattle’s working families in Congress.
We’re in the fight of our lives for a democracy that actually works. For universal healthcare from birth to death, where no one goes bankrupt from getting sick or dies from never getting care. For voting rights and fair elections so every vote counts and power belongs to the people, not to a wannabe king.
I’ve never backed down from a righteous fight and I won’t now.
Donald Trump and his right-wing billionaire allies are determined to stop our movement. Their power, and their profits, depend on the continued exploitation of poor and working people across the country. **And I’ve had enough.**
We need leaders in Congress who stick to their values, who don’t hedge or play it safe when real lives are at stake.
This year’s midterms present a real opportunity to push our movement forward. Donald Trump’s poll numbers are at an all time low, and voters are ready for real change. But make no mistake: the forces who oppose us aren’t going down without a fight.
AIPAC has spent millions meddling in Democratic primaries so far this year, going after any candidate who dares to stand up and speak out for working people.
**And now, right here in Seattle, they are hiring a Director to “grow financial support” for their chosen candidates.**
We need to be prepared for anything and everything they throw at us — and Peter, I’m counting on grassroots supporters like you to help me stand strong and keep up the fight.
I don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, and I don’t have billionaires on speed dial to fund my campaign. I count on regular people who pitch in $5, $15, or $25 at a time to help me keep growing this movement.
**So if you’re ready to help me fight back against AIPAC and the right-wing billionaires propping up the Trump administration,[can I count on you to chip in $3 or any amount that works for you today?](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260508.-1KBGs&refcode=em20260508-6224&amount=3&t=2&akid=6224%2E420207%2EGGZx6G)**
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260508.-1KBGs&amount=3&refcode=em20260508-6224&t=21&akid=6224%2E420207%2EGGZx6G)**
I’m running for Congress because I believe in the power of the PEOPLE. Our democracy is on the line, our futures are on the line.
So, let’s do this — TOGETHER. Our power. Our future.
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20260508-6224-footer&t=22&refcode2=6224_420207_GGZx6G&akid=6224%2E420207%2EGGZx6G)**

body:
You find out your favorite artist is coming to town. You go to buy tickets. The face value is $80, but by the time you check out, you're somehow paying $140.
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=91%2E127862%2E02E6AE)
Folks, here's something that might sound familiar:
You find out your favorite artist is coming to town. You go to buy tickets. The face value is **$80** , but by the time you check out, you're somehow paying **$140**.
It’s because they tacked on service fees... facility fees... order fees... the list goes on.
You pay it anyway, because what choice do you have? Live Nation, which owns Ticketmaster, controls virtually everything — the tickets, the venues, the whole system.
**This is by design to make sure they rake in record profits while you’re feeling squeezed.**
That’s why in 2024, Aaron joined a bipartisan coalition of attorneys general to sue Live Nation for illegally monopolizing the live music market.
But earlier this year, Trump’s Department of Justice reached a settlement that simply doesn’t go far enough. So Aaron continued to litigate, _with or without the federal government._ And he won.
**If there’s one thing to know about Aaron, it’s this: He doesn’t take the easy way out. He stays in the fight for the entirety of the Nevada family.**
That's the same leadership he'll bring to the governor's mansion — taking on the special interests that have rigged the system, and fighting to put power back in the hands of Nevadans.

Friends, Last week, the Supreme Court dealt a near-fatal blow to the Voting Rights Act. After gutting one of the most important civil rights laws in American history, the court moved to rapidly instantiate the ruling to let states implement new racially gerrymandered maps before the midterm elections. The Voting Rights Act was first passed in 1965 by Lyndon B. Johnson, and in combination with the Civil Rights Act of ‘64 became so controversial that party allegiance across the U.S. flipped. Republicans, the party of Lincoln only 100 years prior, became Democrats, a party historically associated with reconstruction-era racial segregation. Southern Democrats fled their party in droves, finding new homes in the Republican coalition. Today, many arguments against the VRA are nested in the same arguments of government overreach, personal freedom, and racial fairness that flipped American politics 60 years ago. In Justice Samuel Alito’s majority opinion, the conservative court reaffirmed these arguments. The opinion claimed that while racial protections were at one point necessary, they had done their job and were no longer needed. Most dangerously, the court claimed that one could gerrymander in a partisan way without racial gerrymandering, even if the outcome directly diminishes the power of racial minority communities. **The Supreme Court just handed every legislature that wishes the opportunity to racially gerrymander their state with a partisan label slapped on top.** [](http://links.votingrightsfund.org/s/c/5ssancc6UFNTqNLaQUqD2H_8jaVsgmK6Ot1Jve2fuuA96HZaIVOYP0ozsrR21WQ_fLwqYIS9Fx88DphO2fNTJzR05nGorWMNmTCK2aHXC7QwhAfrctIL6AW_f_T2iCNaEqAmQ9mgByioo8XvDNPeb7YYmznXBq5DN3pqhA62hugNOArddbvs3Jas9J1E6qorNJBm5dT8vrPX610F-RIEKvXvvppMVt906y9NUEgUAGlRY8D7F_9HApNBffD_Qn7zgpcESGkj1bv-J_T0WJj30CVlRU-HF3nv3Ml9d4GTKnM5A0mLV5gIe-4VUHv4077N9702thdOnSlah0vTzc9PpRJ4q_rd1RJeZ9mqkIceCrxUoqw912YoucwmWWJCc91ZWc1uT58mXhwn1Oyx6r-qECsuD8_Uvo4pq4saJIF8yO_M3p6BGh2MfGMsuyZf53cQoT1sfjTFXek2z9gInHsCDQKvpRiQrdGdEcGrLjJote3N_ugOpUJWVG5U7a_PmnVWnXLUuF8GtZAmoJgIC4JpGmSGTVC7e1gw198G3JfOMO_zT0cwy2PNRNKXSWurJyfz9651SzXE-K-8t8Jmbi1LBqnfPN9QI2WslkXsIBHkjnWR0HKv9JJo-aBwGHlSYXLrkWubEbLUfCbFanzUgITwRN1I2Hmfxb_UGjMEEnh81sOEsHVna1sToiAxJoCRMGsp9-l7vOhyP9T3vGlEoYl0oxMXpUVISHUEINnkYEvRX1EIFaJMA4QpmiY8Ki00qEteRaVq_xJHyYutR-iQKgyVPgSyCf65Bgi1FlbXX9ERO5V0oyEcivi8t8c8LE-vfjXl8P1TOAsRsdIubZ-5l2ZLL5M73R_Y-W6UErZ4CftJYKDgpYpKXLy5TYgn8RFBVvYgc6MfwXwXkr-DyKd88rc5i0K3M7-TjKd32NJ_U7VMW9BX0ghkT9Ms0oE/GkiGL2dXtELg68kV6Ll3BS7Bl64LZp0w/20) The consequences were immediate. In response to this ruling, Alabama, Tennessee, and Louisiana made immediate moves to redraw their maps before the midterm elections, declaring emergencies and tossing out primary votes to enact maps that had previously been rejected under Section 2 of the VRA. Voting Rights Fund has always opposed gerrymandering in all its forms. For as long as the United States has existed, gerrymandering has been a pernicious issue that slowly metastasized into a political weapon. Some states recognized the threat that this erosion posed and required state maps to be drawn by non-partisan independent committees to create districts that were as close to fair as possible. We at VRF support independent commissions as a tool to protect the electorate from partisanship. **Gerrymandering flips the source of power in this country, allowing parties and politicians to choose the voters they want.** **[If extremists in state legislatures are going to use this ruling to weaken minority voting power before the next election, then democracy advocates cannot afford to sit on the sidelines. Most dangerously, the court claimed that one could gerrymander in a partisan way without racial gerrymandering, even if the outcome directly diminishes the power of racial minority communities. The Supreme Court just handed every legislature that wishes the opportunity to racially gerrymander their state with a partisan label slapped on top. The consequences were immediate. In response to this ruling, Alabama, Tennessee, and Louisiana made immediate moves to redraw their maps before the midterm elections, declaring emergencies and tossing out primary votes to enact maps that had previously been rejected under Section 2 of the VRA. Voting Rights Fund has always opposed gerrymandering in all its forms. For as long as the United States has existed, gerrymandering has been a pernicious issue that slowly metastasized into a political weapon. Some states recognized the threat that this erosion posed and required state maps to be drawn by non-partisan independent committees to create districts that were as close to fair as possible. We at VRF support independent commissions as a tool to protect the electorate from partisanship. Gerrymandering flips the source of power in this country, allowing parties and politicians to choose the voters they want. We at VRF will continue to support candidates at the state and federal levels who stand up to partisan bullying and vote to keep the power with people. —Daniel Weiss Executive Director Voting Rights Fund | Voting Rights Fund wasn’t created just to defend voting rights — we elect the leaders who will expand and protect them. Our aim is to keep our operational costs as low as possible, so a majority of our funds go toward doing the work that needs to be done. That means building a national bench of lawmakers who will fight tooth and nail to expand access to the ballot box and protect our right to vote at every level of government. There is no clearer example of this than with the passage of the landmark reconciliation legislation, the Working Families Tax Cuts Act, which delivered a major win for families across the country. Alabama’s own Senator Katie Britt was instrumental in ensuring the law was enacted this summer, and she took a leading role in advancing the pro-family provisions.

In Alabama, where childcare costs families over $8,000 annually, Sen. Britt’s work will have a major impact on Alabama’s families, small businesses, economy, and overall well-being for years to come.

Most Senate Republicans helped advance President Trump’s priorities in this bill, but Britt took it a step further. Knowing that families are the backbone of American society, the senator fervently advocated for policy changes that will impact working parents, in particular.

Patriot,

I promise I won’t take up much of your time.

In my film _2000 Mules_ , I exposed one of the greatest scandals in American history - the hijacking of the 2020 presidential election.

Today, I'm proud to join forces with Stand in the Gap, a non-profit organization dedicated to supporting the patriots who exercised their First Amendment rights in protest of the _outcome_ of that election.

**I want to reach as many people as I can with this request...**

I told their founder, Shane Jenkins, that I would help him raise $20,000 before the end of the month to help Stand in the Gap provide help, hope, and healing to the January 6th patriots.

Even a donation of $10 can give a January 6th patriot the support they need.

[If that is all you need to hear, then please contribute $10 or any amount you can generously afford using the button below:](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
[Donate Now](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
**Otherwise, let me explain why I’m asking you to donate at least $10:**

$10 because the _“crime”_ these patriots committed was fighting for their country.

$10 because even though they’ve been pardoned, many of them are struggling to get back on their feet.

$10 because Stand in the Gap is providing them with the resources they need to successfully reintegrate into their communities, find work, reconnect with family, and restore their rights.

[$10 because no one should have to face these hardships alone.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

Not only are these men and women patriots, but they come from all walks of life — law enforcement, veterans, white-collar professionals, blue-collar workers, and all races and religions.

_And they were hunted down in a political persecution that denied them their constitutional rights._

**Stand in the Gap exists to provide real, practical help, like rent money, job training, transportation, legal referrals, trauma counseling, and health insurance, to help these persecuted patriots move on with their lives.**

Your gift today can help one of these patriots find the help, hope, and healing they need to succeed in their second chance.

**Patriot, can I count on you to contribute $10 or whatever you can afford to Stand in the Gap? Click any button below to give today.**
[Donate $10](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[Donate $35](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[Donate $1,000](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[Donate Any Other Amount](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
Thank you,
Dinesh D'Souza

P.S. If you're still reading this email and I haven't convinced you to donate $10 or more, please consider what January 6th patriots still face...
* Harassment on social media and in their personal lives
* Difficulties in finding a job
* Homelessness
* Loss of rights, like the right to vote or own a firearm
* Mental health challenges that their families can never understand

All they did was stand up for their beliefs. They do not deserve this sort of treatment.

But for just $10, you can help Stand in the Gap give pardoned January 6th patriots the support they need to succeed at their second chance.
[Donate Now](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

name: America Fitzpatrick, LCV
subject: TAKE ACTION: Protect Public Lands!
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM2OTc1MjES1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjQ2MDU2NDc5NgS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Stop the Sell-Off!

Since Trump came back into office, his administration has been relentlessly
trying to sell off our nation’s most treasured public lands and parks to Big
Polluters for oil and gas drilling and mining. Trump and congressional
Republicans are taking steps to sell off Chaco Canyon, Grand Staircase-Escalante, AND the Arctic Refuge to the
highest bidder — it’s time to speak out.

These lands are irreplaceable. Let’s make sure they’re protected for future
generations, not exploited and polluted for Big Oil’s profits. We need to keep
the pressure up.

Tell Secretary Burgum: Don’t sell off our public lands. Not now, not ever. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_ ADD YOUR NAME https://links.messages.lcv. Peter, Public lands belong in public hands — not to corporate oil and gas developers. Since Trump came back into office, his administration has been relentlessly
trying to sell off our nation’s most treasured public lands and parks to Big
Polluters for oil and gas drilling and mining. Trump and congressional
Republicans are taking steps to sell off Chaco Canyon, Grand
Staircase-Escalante, and the Arctic Refuge — it’s time to speak out. Tell Secretary Burgum our public lands are not for sale. https://links.messages.lcv. Right now, the administration has its sights set on Chaco Canyon, the ancestral
home of the Pueblo people, and a site of deep cultural, archeological, and
historical significance to dozens of Tribal Nations throughout the Southwest.
The administration is trying to revoke the Greater Chaco mineral withdrawal,
which prohibits new oil and gas leasing on roughly 336,000 acres of federal
lands bordering Chaco Culture National Historical Park. If the Department of the
Interior moves forward with this proposal, new oil and gas drilling will be allowed within 10 miles of the park’s
boundaries, threatening irreplaceable cultural and environmental resources, and posing
serious health risks to local communities. Before that, MAGA lawmakers introduced a plan to gut protections for Grand
Staircase-Escalante by overturning its management plan. Current protections
cover nearly 1.9 million acresof canyons, ancient fossil beds, sacred cultural sites, and essential wildlife
habitat for endangered and protected species like the California condor and Bald
Eagle. This plan puts it all at risk. AND congressional Republicans are still going after one of our Earth's last wild places — the Arctic Refuge. If drilling ever were to occur, it would have disastrous consequences for the
Gwich'in people and other Indigenous communities, as well as for our climate. So
far, the environmental movement has been able to hold the line to keep Big Oil
out, but we must continue to speak up so they hear loud and clear. These are just a few of the irreplaceable public lands the administration has
gone after this year. So far, the environmental movement — thanks to opposition
from people like you — have kept them at bay. We can’t let up now. Don’t wait — tell Secretary Burgum to protect our public lands today. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/- When we speak up together, we can ensure our public lands are protected for
generations to come. Thank you for taking action for people and our planet. America Fitzpatrick
Conservation Program Director
League of Conservation Voters This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. A Shark Tank investor, Kevin O'Leary, wants to build a data center in Utah powered by a private gas plant that burns more than twice the energy of our entire state, to run AI. Governor Cox and state leaders are fast-tracking it through a military loophole, with zero impact studies and a public process designed to keep us out.
It's called Stratos and once built, it will occupy forty thousand acres in Box Elder County with giant warehouses stuffed with servers running AI for whichever hyperscaler, Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, Apple, signs the lease. Your chatbot question in Tokyo gets answered by a server in Box Elder County. The profits fly to Wall Street. The pollution stays here.
This project isn't going through normal county zoning. It's being pushed through MIDA (Utah's Military Installation Development Authority) by calling it a national security project. That label lets it skip the rules every other developer in Utah has to follow. MIDA admitted on the record: there's been no environmental study, no traffic study, no studies at all for forty thousand acres, a 9 Gigawatt natural gas plant larger than anything in Utah's history, and up to 13,000 acre-feet of water rights (which is over 4 billion gallons a year). They wanted a vote without a single study.
They got it.
