## Approved Without a Single Public Comment
On May 4, the Box Elder County Commission approved the agreement. They declined to hear public comment. Hundreds of residents showed up anyway, holding signs in the back of the room while commissioners voted away their valley.
Even the Republican commissioners had been sounding alarms days earlier. Commissioner Tyler Vincent called it "drinking from a fire hose." Commissioner Boyd Bingham said: "if we vote for this, we lose control."
They voted yes anyway.
The first time most Utahns heard about Stratos was a few weeks before the vote. MIDA had been quietly working on it for a year.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a7a177c1-7d65-4043-9c7d-03f36e6364eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
May 5, 2026 Box Elder County Commission Meeting by Kenneth Wasall
## The "Paid Protesters" Smear
After the vote, Kevin O'Leary, Mr. Wonderful from Shark Tank, the project's celebrity face, did something straight out of the DARVO playbook. Deny, Attack, Reverse Victim and Offender.
He went on social media and told the country that the people opposing his project weren't really Utahns. He claimed, without evidence, that "over 90% of the protesters are actually not people who live in Utah." He called them "professional protesters," but he said Utahns weren't stupid and would see right through out-of-state interests making decisions about their state. Project CEO Paul Palandjian called them "paid thugs" bused in from out of state.
The actual record: no bus was observed, the protesters were Utahns. Neighbors, ranchers, mothers driving to the county building during nap time because they saw it on Facebook that morning. The only out-of-state person flying in to make decisions about Utah was Kevin O'Leary. Every accusation is a confession. When the developer can't win the argument or answer the questions, he attacks.
## Cox at the Podium
A few days before the county vote, the Governor went to his monthly press conference and went off.
He said every state has "an obligation" to host data centers like this one. He said taking time to study things is "the dumbest thing ever." He said people who object to industrial projects have "destroyed our country, destroyed our industrial base, destroyed our mining base." He said: "those days are over. We're done with that." He compared it to the nuclear arms race. He said it was a national security imperative. He also said it wasn't really about the economy.
If it's not really about the economy, then why are we handing so much water to it? If it's not about jobs, then what IS Utah getting in exchange for a 9 gigawatt gas plant in one of the driest states in the nation? If it's about national security, why it is being championed by a reality TV investor whose last data center campus has been stalled for a year?
## What Utah Gets
In exchange for our water, our air, and 40,000 acres: MIDA slashed its standard 6% energy tax to 0.5%. Eighty percent of the property tax flows back to the developer as a rebate. Personal property tax on the equipment is waived entirely. Box Elder County is promised $30 million a year early on, $100 million at full buildout, which is pennies against what the developer keeps.
O'Leary himself, on Facebook in February, said the project needs "every incentive we can get out of that state." The deal only works because Utah agreed to give it.
We hand over the water, the air, and the land. They hand us a check and a thank-you note.
This data center was approved without studies, without an opportunity for public comment, in a process most of us never heard of. Box Elder County Residents have filed a referendum to undo the County Commissioner's approval. It's pending and if approved, the decision will go back to the voters.
This should be a warning to every other American. This is not how government is supposed to work, in Utah and America. But Utahn's aren't dumb, and we are fighting.

Republican Task Force Issue: 5/8/2026

Iran Ceasefire Fraying

Iran [attacked three American guided-missile destroyers](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDmO5DAUQ08jZzK0eA0UTOKsJp3Q-NZSJZRsCV_fY9TtG-6gD9AJA4J4JPjvsT4gpng8_8LuDVJYXXarzScSvTBfNZ_k_J4tAu1QViXUwEXPxbQeaZWNM846kLbxRo7jpCYlxdC8jA6gZxek1toJrcexm7peu3nWQ5Bqk000N0r0YlJa9qJvQzfZYZ67roegLUysE5A8Uou-nFuKFg6C-g4ZrW9t3ptkXkSlMv2HqYWp5bqudkMfaQOkO8HUUnKKFG1larnrmFpEf8vI1EJ47oVHhCPCwYEI7Ntj5TbvJXny6cOdr4T54x0PEePx5CevPybe1AaNK1dMKdZhZJ147hDT9zz6xZv_jfoKAAD__3JkhWE) transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday, launching missiles, drones, and fast-attack boats at the vessels, according to U.S. Central Command. Trump told reporters [the ceasefire is "still in effect,"](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0D1uxCAUBODT2B0Wxj_ggiKNu02b0np-wBotGOsZL0lOH-0eIeWnkUaj-botN_DB7_dPiFZTdotJZsF0Uc4bpXKmKxsbExLkCMciuBgZHxhXyx6WtjbaoIEWa6tbKZVQouVjvWkccZpaKeUq-WQU8LbjcsVBOTGOgK72-lXFB65E1w58aFyvcJymvh_AdQiq6jkES7khe1xr8Ah7hvPhEqFtMMU66C3n46y6j0rMlZhLKY1L37st5yuvxBz807KXKzF7gp0VoLdZpise7MwEPrMtUbx-2RoSPsBYhhZO6zxZFuGHqZq0OYoPwZ-jrHp-j-DDe0H-x2FPLf4CAAD__5X2fXM) calling the exchange "just a love tap" as U.S. forces struck back and destroyed the attacking Iranian units. The president posted on Truth Social that American destroyers had already navigated out of the strait. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) declared the ceasefire broken Friday morning. Tehran is simultaneously [reviewing a one-page U.S. peace proposal](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2unTAQhJ_GdEZmweBTuEhDd9OmRIt_DtYxGK2Xi_L2EXmE20w1mvn0_flavjDldLx_4x4scVx88YsrFzFvVO5aLvZhL46QdzwXUDBKpaUyy5GXrvHWO4-da4LtpsmAgU6NzWZhBTCTiTj0a1TjOuBk9Kv3btRaY-yaZJ8ppZWBvtNKt3Ewbny9hkFj7B0aMSjMgbilcF5rTg4PxvqJhVxoXdmbbDfms4r-l4BZwHzfd7tSSLwi8dMQMO_J-xxkwMoC5udRwKz0E0bAnAgPWfFvlS5gDTFRkCuVTzgkRg4kL1llLt9BMp4y0dtJLjLjdbhNIjO6TxUwN2T9eaecUx0nMaj3jin_Z-QfKP228C8AAP__Cu6GVg) delivered through Pakistani mediators, with both sides having traded gunfire multiple times since the April 7 ceasefire began. ★★★
Virginia Map Blocked

The Virginia Supreme Court [voted 4-3 Friday](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGO6yAURL8Gd0SADcYFxWvc5bVbWgSu7asFY8F18vurZP9g6xkdzZmv-3L3mPDY_vsMrtK6xBKXUK5KtNfyauWiCLmE6in7c1FCGS40F3Y50iK76GKIXoYOnBxHq6ySwnS7G0exjlaBgh4kGC2NDnG0PSj1CMZMHbo3SmhhVS-10Ld1sMFM0zBov_bBWzYIn6DSrcJ5PRIGf5Bv32upAW6h5C65nehsrP_H1MzUTDvsmNI7Y2qusF3JE5aDqfnjwx-eKEFjatbWTEYa_sS64YGet-uskIH_Fqm0Bo1XiNioYiA8Np79yT_2GSNBzW9OV108X5gSNjOyQWzZ42dAR3_48unUTwAAAP__bqaFkw) to strike down a voter-approved redistricting referendum, ruling that lawmakers failed to follow the constitutional procedures required to place the measure on the ballot. The ruling wipes out four newly drawn Democratic-leaning congressional districts and hands Republicans a structural midterm advantage. [Democrats had projected](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGurCAURb9GOwygIhYUr7Gb177SnHc4OuQiEMDhfv7NzCfceid7Za1_j_0Bzrtw_oWLTK7HbqPdMd651meOrcS7WroiZqgXpF1yqRifGdd78LvorbFoQWBPRiyLlloKrvqnUVbIRaLSq8IFhKCRc61wJTmOhBx6Z95XfOZajmLm83BMGtW6TtMMx4igu4mDp1yHTOn-7x1CqFC-jpiRBoxX782z1lS68U8nt05urbXhiN-BWnnvndxS9K46LJ3cXi6fLjhg5U6ZLmIfRZZvT4UFagxjODOV4mIAzy5IfTY2Nee9K2rpJn5e4PwHXH_R6WXkTwAAAP__PwB6pw) the redrawn map would flip up to four Republican-held House seats in 2026. Trump called it ["a huge win"](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LHOpCAUBeCnwU4DKIoFxTZ2_7ZbGoSL3gyCueC4j7-ZeYTtT76cc_78rD8WI6b9tz3BUA2rz351-aZaD8pPyXf1cGZHtp72WiWXY8tVy_Wa4ioab7zzVrgGjJgmLbUUfGwOo6Zt5gKC7J0W4zZsm5bB9mEGzaVSvEHzobjiWvZCcdWFQbtxnodB2dA7q9nAbQSqHcF1bxGdTdWWV8jkoHP5bKI5ar0K638xuTC5PM_TPbYcmPaaE_y1JyagT5TJJcFTmFwGpcSoNJPLG2nHhLYt90VwQvvd3G4xu1dpCTyWSugqpr0lCECQ_P2RGjL-ejBGLOPEBr6fFuO3UP2P_95G_gsAAP__vwyCPg) on Truth Social. Virginia Democrats said the legislature will "respect" the ruling, leaving the party without a congressional redistricting path in the state heading into November. ★★★

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Sorry to reach out again,
Derek, but I have an important
question:

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/622?t=1001&akid=38%2E245147%2Ezo3l3R ]Will you sign your name and personally endorse my campaign for
reelection? We’re less than two weeks out from Primary Day, and every
signature we collect will help us build up our grassroots momentum in
these critical final days before the election.→

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/622?t=1002&akid=38%2E245147%2Ezo3l3R ]Sign Your Name →

Listen, I know an official endorsement is a big step — and it’s not an ask
I make lightly. So if you’re on the fence, I want to tell you a little bit
more about myself and this campaign.

I always knew I wanted to give back to Pennsylvanians in some way or
another. But when I saw what dedicated, focused public service could
accomplish for folks all across the Commonwealth, I knew I could do the
same.

So as a State Representative, I helped pass some of the toughest ethics
laws in Pennsylvania history. As Montgomery County Commissioner, I led a
fiscal turnaround. As Attorney General, I took on health care corporations
and protected affordable care for thousands of families across Western PA.

And now as your Governor? We’re Getting Sh*t Done in every county and
every community across our great Commonwealth.

I know what committed, determined governance can accomplish.
And Derek, we all
know what cruel, chaotic governance can rip away.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/622?t=1003&akid=38%2E245147%2Ezo3l3R ]So today, I’m asking you to personally endorse our campaign. In a
battleground state like Pennsylvania, the strength of our grassroots team
is everything on Election Day — so every endorsement we collect makes a
difference.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/622?t=1004&akid=38%2E245147%2Ezo3l3R ]Sign Your Name →

Thank you,

Josh Shapiro

Tuesday night was a political whiplash for former Vice President Mike Pence in his home state of Indiana, as multiple candidates tied to Pence were decisively[ rejected](https://substack.com/redirect/daa547dd-69e6-44f8-be78-000b29482bd4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Republican primary voters and replaced by Trump-endorsed America First challengers.
LOOMER UNLEASHED is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..FJ17KjC7K8s-War_xHY4ODXCGI0p_ivlJcv9QpWlB_s?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=196812992)
The results sent a loud and unmistakable message from Indiana Republicans: the days of Mike Pence controlling Indiana Republican politics are over.
Indiana's failed congressional redistricting fight was front and center. After several establishment Republicans sided with Democrats to block efforts aimed at protecting Republican congressional power ahead of the midterms, the issue became a litmus test for GOP voters. Lawmakers who opposed the redistricting effort paid a heavy political price.
One of the biggest casualties of the night was Indiana State Senator Jim Buck, whom Mike Pence personally [endorsed](https://substack.com/redirect/cce0d7d3-c5e0-43d1-91f3-695aefe4b0b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for reelection just weeks ago. Buck was crushed by Trump-endorsed challenger Tracey Powell in the Republican primary for Indiana Senate District 21. Official election results showed Powell defeating Buck by nearly 30 points, receiving 64.7% of the vote to Buck's 35.3%.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9996c9bd-157c-4d09-b315-ed4e0bbcbc4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7e82fa5e-c999-4301-8d43-99127e3e2b9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Buck became a top target for conservatives after voting against Indiana's 2025 congressional redistricting plan, HB 1032, in December. Despite Buck siding with Democrats, Pence rushed to publicly support him in April, praising Buck as _" one of Indiana's most conservative state legislators."_
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..FJ17KjC7K8s-War_xHY4ODXCGI0p_ivlJcv9QpWlB_s?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=196812992)
The endorsement immediately backfired. President Trump aggressively [campaigned ](https://substack.com/redirect/b13b580e-0a70-4824-860d-b129c0d3e0be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)against Buck on Truth Social, calling him a _" pathetic RINO incumbent" _who voted against redistricting _" which puts the United States Congress in jeopardy."_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2a120cad-dacd-4464-b08a-17a55c6c4844?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Indiana voters listened, and Buck wasn't the only Pence ally rejected Tuesday night. Indiana State Senator Travis Holdman suffered a humiliating defeat after opposing the redistricting plan. Holdman lost to Trump-[endorsed](https://substack.com/redirect/d5808b2e-7d13-4273-a019-ccb94056ab15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Blake Fiechter by more than 20 points.
FEC records show Holdman financially backed Mike Pence's failed 2024 presidential campaign against President Trump, further tying him to the collapsing Pence political operation.

clean_body: [] I’m Dr. Annie Andrews, a pediatrician, a mom of three, and the Democrat running for U.S. Senate to defeat Republican Lindsey Graham in South Carolina. If we flip this seat, we can end Lindsey Graham’s career and help Democrats retake the Senate, and expand the map for Democrats in future elections. I know this won’t be easy. But I’ve treated kids who were shot, hospitalized, and failed by broken systems. Nothing about this moment feels optional. We need an overwhelming surge of grassroots support to prove that we can finally defeat Lindsey Graham. So I’m humbly asking: Will you chip in a split donation of $50, $30, or even $15 between Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign right now so we can hit our end of quarter goals? >> [] [] HELP ME DEFEAT LINDSEY GRAHAM! >> [] Let me introduce myself. I’ve spent nearly 20 years serving my community as a pediatrician, treating everything from asthma and violent trauma to the emotional toll of growing up in poverty. I’ve seen what bad policy does to good families — and I’ve seen kids suffer because people like Lindsey Graham would rather protect their own power than protect children. In 2022, after 15 years of working in hospitals, I ran for Congress because I knew our kids needed a voice in Washington. I lost — and I told my oldest daughter I wouldn’t run again. But then Trump’s chaos came back. And Lindsey Graham? He cheered. The truth is, I’m scared. And I’m angry. And I’m done waiting. So I’m stepping up — because our kids, and this country can’t afford another six years of Lindsey Graham. I’m building a people-powered campaign to flip South Carolina and give kids the voice they deserve. And I need your help.
